The Emperor’s moods were unpredictable. How could Rongyan handle that?

---

chapters.title: Entering the Palace
chapters.content:
Inside the room, Baozhu was still kneeling on the ground, crying. “This servant doesn’t know what happened either. Halfway there, I tripped on a stone and fell, hitting my head on a rock and passing out.”

“If I hadn’t fallen, I could have called Madam in time.”

“Then this wouldn’t have happened.”

Xi Rongyan now realized she had caused a disaster.

She weakly supported herself on the edge of the bed, looking at Baozhu kneeling on the floor, her mind in a daze. “I clearly went to Qing Shan Ju. I remember I didn’t make a mistake. Why…”

Baozhu wiped her tears with her sleeve. “This servant also remembers it was Qing Shan Ju, but when I ran out to look, it had turned into Qing Yue Ju.”

“I really didn’t expect to go to the wrong place.”

“Young Lady, please believe me.”

With that, she covered her face and sobbed loudly.

Madam Xie glanced at Baozhu, who was crying on the floor, her own heart in turmoil, her head throbbing. “Go get your wound dressed first.”

After Baozhu wiped her tears and left, Madam Xie turned back to Xi Rongyan, gripping her hand tightly as she wiped away tears. “Your father didn’t expect His Majesty to issue the decree so quickly either.”

“At this point, the only option is to enter the palace. Otherwise, it would be defying the imperial decree.”

“It’s all because of that unfortunate wrong turn.”

“The Emperor is the supreme ruler. How can we defy him?”

Xi Rongyan still felt as if this were unreal.

She opened her mouth, but she couldn’t remember anything from when she was drunk. Only then did she realize she couldn’t say a word.

After a long while, she finally looked at her mother with a pale face and asked seriously, “Is there really no other way?”

“I’m afraid of His Majesty. I don’t want to enter the palace.”

Madam Xie pulled Xi Rongyan’s thin body into her arms, her eyes filling with tears. “I can’t bear to part with you either.”

“But that scene… there really is no other way. Your body was indeed seen by His Majesty.”

“Do you think I want you to enter the palace?”

Xi Rongyan’s mind was still in a haze.

A ray of light fell on her from outside, as if she had been dreaming.

---

Over the next two days, Xi Rongyan felt as if she were floating. Her mother selected reliable maids for her and prepared a box of silver and jewelry so she could tip the servants in the palace.

It was also by His Majesty’s grace that a message was sent allowing Xi Rongyan to bring two of her own maids into the palace.

Madam Zhao hastily selected steadfast and clever maids for Xi Rongyan.

Xi Rongyan had grown up under her mother’s care, and since there were no other women in the main branch of the family to cause strife, she had never been exposed to such matters and naturally didn’t understand them.

The Gu family also had a reputation for uprightness—unless a woman couldn’t bear children by the age of thirty, they would not take concubines. Thus, Madam Xie had never thought to teach her daughter those things.

But the palace was different. With so many women, even if Xi Rongyan didn’t compete or fight, she might not be able to live peacefully.

Madam Xie gave Xi Rongyan one of her own trusted personal maids to take into the palace with her.

Xi Rongyan held the box her mother had given her, listening to her mother’s anxious instructions: “After entering the palace, you must take good care of the servants.”

“Many of them may seem insignificant, but they can cause trouble behind your back in ways you can’t guard against. Reward those who deserve it. If you run out of silver, send word back.”

“As for His Majesty’s other women, I already told you yesterday how to interact with them.”

“Yu Mian is your cousin, and you two have always been close. She won’t harm you. When you arrive, remember to spend more time with her so you can look out for each other.”

“Also, I’ve heard that His Majesty currently favors Wang Xiuyi. You must remember not to compete with her. Don’t show off, keep a low profile, and focus on bearing a child—that’s the most important thing.”

“What’s even more important is this: favor or not doesn’t matter. Favor is like a mirage. His Majesty has so many women, and there will always be younger, more beautiful ones entering the palace. It’s all just temporary favor—none of it lasts.”

“Do you understand?”

Xi Rongyan lowered her head, staring at the box in her hands, listening dazedly to her mother’s words.

She had never imagined that one day she would enter the palace.

She recalled the woman under the white cloth, covered in blood, her face pale.

If she hadn’t taken the wrong turn that day, would she have avoided this situation?

Madam Xie looked at Xi Rongyan’s confused and innocent expression, and her heart ached again. She pulled Xi Rongyan tightly into her arms, tears falling once more. “Tomorrow, someone from the palace will come. You must remember everything your mother has told you.”

“In the harem, a woman only has it easier once she has a child. I know you won’t compete and don’t know how to compete. It’s good that you won’t compete—just live quietly.”

“But don’t let others bully you either.”

Only then did Xi Rongyan embrace her mother, her voice hoarse as she said, “I understand.”

The next morning, the imperial procession arrived early.

The Xi family, dressed in their finest, stood at the gate and saw Xi Rongyan into the soft sedan chair waiting there.

As Xi Rongyan sat inside, she still felt dazed. Only when the sedan chair was lifted did she anxiously push open the curtain. Her restless eyes looked at Madam Xie, whose own eyes were red with tears. “Mother…”

Madam Xie dabbed at her tears with a handkerchief, choking back sobs, unable to speak.

As the figure of the person seeing her off grew smaller and smaller, and the familiar surroundings faded away, Xi Rongyan felt her vision blur, her chin growing cold.

She touched it with her finger—it was wet.

It was High Eunuch Gao who had come to welcome her personally. Seeing Xi Rongyan’s tearful eyes, he walked beside the sedan chair, his voice carrying a hint of comfort. “Consort Xi, don’t be afraid. His Majesty treats Consort Xi differently.”

Xi Rongyan pressed the handkerchief to her face. To her, High Eunuch Gao’s words were just empty reassurance.

With so many women in the harem, what could be different?

Her mind flashed with images of high walls and green tiles, and she still felt uneasy.

The sedan chair traveled along the palace path and stopped directly in front of Guan Ju Palace.

Xi Rongyan stepped out of the sedan chair. The solid green bricks beneath her feet gave her a sense of reality. She looked up at the towering palace gates.

High Eunuch Gao stood beside Xi Rongyan with a smile. “His Majesty has specially arranged for Consort Xi to live in the Han Yuan Hall of Guan Ju Palace from now on. Everything inside has already been prepared. Consort Xi will reside in the main hall.”

Xi Rongyan had been told by her mother before entering the palace that those below the rank of concubine were not allowed to live in the main hall. She had also been instructed to maintain a good relationship with the mistress of the main hall.

She thought she must have misheard. She turned to High Eunuch Gao in surprise. “How can I live in the main hall?”

High Eunuch Gao looked at Xi Rongyan and smiled. “His Majesty is showing favor to Consort Xi. This is imperial grace.”

Xi Rongyan remembered her mother’s advice: in the palace, she must keep a low profile. She was only a consort—living in the main hall of Han Yuan Hall would inevitably invite gossip and go against the rules.

She couldn’t understand why His Majesty would give such an order. After all, she had only met him a few times.

Unless she had done something that day.

But she couldn’t remember anything.

She hesitated, but High Eunuch Gao was already urging her. “Consort Xi, go in and take a look. See if anything is missing, and this servant will have someone attend to it.”

It was morning, and the light was just right. She stepped into the palace and immediately noticed the peach tree planted in the center of the inner courtyard.

Peach trees had also been planted all around, their pink blossoms in full bloom. Petals danced in the wind, carrying a faint fragrance.

High Eunuch Gao observed Xi Rongyan’s expression as he led her into the main hall. “His Majesty heard that Consort Xi likes peach blossoms, so he ordered people to plant them here two days ago.”

He then smiled. “In the three years this servant has served His Majesty, I’ve never seen him take such pains for anyone else.”

The large doors slowly opened, and a wisp of dust scattered. Xi Rongyan listened to High Eunuch Gao’s words as she looked at the spacious interior furnishings. To her surprise, everything was arranged to her taste.

High Eunuch Gao glanced at Xi Rongyan’s expression from the corner of his eye and continued leading her inside. “This is a four-room suite, and a small study has been specially prepared. Consort Xi, take a look. If anything displeases you, this servant will have it replaced.”

Xi Rongyan walked forward step by step. Every part of the arrangement was exquisite. From the small inner hall to the inner chamber, the floor was covered with sheep’s wool rugs. Behind the fragrant gauze curtains stood a four-panel screen depicting a hundred flowers in bloom.

The small, delicate objects on the antique shelves were each uniquely charming.

Even the maids following behind Xi Rongyan were stunned.

They had assumed that, as a consort, she would only be given two simple rooms with modest furnishings. They never expected such a fine arrangement.

It was even more elegant than the young lady’s boudoir.

Finally, they reached the innermost room, where a carved rosewood bed hung with jade ornaments stood. On the dressing table sat an eight-treasure mirror and a crane-shaped lamp inlaid with pearls.

Xi Rongyan stared in a daze before looking back at High Eunuch Gao.

After a long moment, she said, “Everything is satisfactory.”

“It’s just…”

chapters.title: No One Can Compare to Consort Xi
chapters.content:
Xi Rongyan hesitated, wanting to speak but holding back.

Eunuch Gao naturally understood what Xi Rongyan wanted to say.

A woman who had just entered the palace could live here, and such careful arrangements had been made—wasn’t this an unparalleled favor? If the Emperor hadn’t been worried that too much favor too soon would draw attention, he might have even bestowed the title of Imperial Concubine upon her right away.

How many women in the harem had spent their entire lives longing for a position like that? Yet this one had only appeared before the Emperor twice, and now she had everything.

In truth, Gao Yi didn’t understand either. The Emperor was so deep in thought, so cold and detached—why was he treating the Fourth Miss Xi so differently?

He smiled at Xi Rongyan. "His Majesty is currently in the Qinzheng Hall. Once he is free, he will come to see you."

As he spoke, Gao Yi called for the matron in charge of the Hanyuan Palace and had her introduce the palace maids serving there to Xi Rongyan. Then he said to her, "You’ve just entered the palace. Rest for a while. This servant will go and report to His Majesty first."

Xi Rongyan knew that some questions might not get answers from Eunuch Gao.

She steadied her thoughts and had Yuzhu see him out.

Yuzhu agreed and escorted Eunuch Gao outside. Then, from her sleeve, she took out a large ingot of silver and pressed it into his hand, smiling. "Our mistress has just entered the palace and still has much to learn. In the future, we will trouble Eunuch Gao to guide her."

Yuzhu was a senior maid who had served the Madame Xie. She carried herself with a calm and steady demeanor, speaking softly and politely.

Gao Yi chuckled and pushed the silver back. "Rest assured. In this palace, no one can compare to Consort Xi."

With that, he smiled and left.

Yuzhu didn’t fully grasp the meaning of Eunuch Gao’s words, but seeing him walk away, she could only turn back.

Inside the hall, Xi Rongyan was seated on a large armchair, listening to the matron introduce the palace attendants. There were seven palace maids serving in the Hanyuan Palace, and with those Xi Rongyan had brought, there were now nine.

Yuzhu gave a few instructions on Xi Rongyan’s behalf and had Baozhu distribute rewards.

The rewards had been prepared by Madame Xie early that morning: each person received an exquisitely carved small box containing a jade hairpin and a small handful of silver ingots.

The palace maids exchanged glances, silently marveling at the generosity, and quickly knelt to express their gratitude.

Xi Rongyan headed toward the inner chamber. Yuzhu followed behind her, whispering a reminder: "When we entered the palace earlier, someone from Her Majesty the Empress Dowager came to inform us. Now, Mistress should go see Her Majesty the Empress Dowager."

"After we leave Her Majesty the Empress Dowager’s place, we will go to pay respects to Her Majesty the Empress."

Xi Rongyan knew she couldn’t rest yet.

She sat at the dressing table, letting Baozhu tidy her appearance, and asked Yuzhu, "Did you bring the box Mother prepared?"

Yuzhu smiled. "Mistress, rest assured. Everything is in order. We’ve prepared something special for Her Majesty the Empress Dowager."

Only then did Xi Rongyan turn to look at her reflection in the mirror. Her hairpin was neat, her makeup was light and clean, and everything was proper and in place. Then she stood up.

But just as she stepped out of the inner chamber, the matron, Fang, entered and knelt before Xi Rongyan, softly relaying a message: "Yu Mama from Her Majesty the Empress’s side has come to invite Mistress to the Yongchun Palace."

Yuzhu had Fang go ahead and tell Yu Mama that Mistress would come after finishing her preparations. Then she whispered to Xi Rongyan, "The Empress’s father is His Majesty’s most capable subordinate. Now he is stationed in the north, the most trusted man by His Majesty’s side."

"Mistress should go see Her Majesty the Empress first."

Xi Rongyan already knew all this. Her mother had told her everything last night.

Back when the Emperor returned from the north, it was General Song, the Empress’s father, who had led 20,000 soldiers to surround the imperial city.

Her mother had said that General Song had followed the Emperor since he was still a prince. The north was entirely under the Emperor’s command, and only someone he trusted implicitly would be stationed there.

Unless the Empress committed a grave mistake, her position was the most secure.

Xi Rongyan nodded. Her aunt wouldn’t blame her for the delay, but the Empress might.

After a moment of consideration, she decided to go to the Empress first.

But just as she stepped outside the hall, preparing to send someone to inform the Empress Dowager, a palace maid from the Empress Dowager’s side arrived in person to invite her.

Elderly Maid Wan, upon seeing Xi Rongyan, smiled and said, "Mistress Xi, please come with me to see Her Majesty the Empress Dowager. She has been waiting for you since early this morning and has many things to discuss with you."

Xi Rongyan hesitated. "Just now, Her Majesty the Empress sent someone to call for me. Let me go see her first, then I’ll visit my aunt."

Elderly Maid Wan smiled. "The Empress can wait a little. Mistress Xi, rest assured. Her Majesty the Empress Dowager will send word to Her Majesty the Empress."

"The Empress won’t mind. She won’t blame you."

"Her Majesty the Empress Dowager has been waiting for you since early morning."

Xi Rongyan heard this and hesitated for a moment. But then she thought of her prior promise to her aunt and decided to follow Elderly Maid Wan to the Cining Palace.

---

Meanwhile, in the Yongchun Palace, Empress Song Helan sat at the head of the room. The incense on the side table curled with fragrant mist. She appeared calm, her long nails gently stroking the white cat in her lap as she listened to the voices below, her eyes revealing no emotion.

She heard Yellow Honored Consort’s voice: "Isn’t it because she has Her Majesty the Empress Dowager backing her?"

"It’s only her first day in the palace, yet we have to send someone to invite her, and now we’re all waiting for her. She’s got quite the nerve."

Beside her, Consort Tan chimed in with a faintly sarcastic smile. "Isn’t that a lot of nerve?"

"And the Gu family’s downfall was less than two months ago. Now she’s rushing into the palace. It’s likely that Her Majesty the Empress Dowager arranged for her to enter. She probably thinks that as the Empress Dowager’s niece, she doesn’t even need to pay respect to Her Majesty the Empress."

As she spoke, she glanced at Wang Xiuyi. "She was granted the title of Consort Xi as soon as she entered, and I hear His Majesty even let her stay in the main hall of Hanyuan Palace. Even you, dear sister, haven’t received such treatment despite your favor."

Wang Baoran clenched her hands tightly but kept a faint smile on her face, her voice tinged with sarcasm. "She is Her Majesty the Empress Dowager’s niece. How can I compare?"

The Empress had remained silent the entire time, neither expressing her stance nor telling the others to stop.

She had followed the Emperor since he was still a prince. She knew better than anyone that the Emperor never acted based on anyone’s influence.

Not even the Empress Dowager could decide who entered the palace on his behalf.

She recalled what she had said to the Emperor last night when she went to see him.

She had said that it was improper for Xi Rongyan to live in the Hanyuan Palace upon entering the palace.

Being granted the title of Consort Xi was one thing, but allowing a Consort to reside in the main hall of the Hanyuan Palace was a clear sign of favoritism, which could spark gossip in the harem.

She had only advised him as the Empress, hoping to maintain balance and peace in the harem. Whether her intentions were selfish or not, she had to speak up.

But the man sitting on the cold desk, dressed in black robes with golden embroidery, didn’t even glance at her. He coldly uttered two words: "Leave."

Like two sharp knives piercing her heart.

The so-called childhood sweethearts, after all, amounted to nothing.

She didn’t know what made Xi Rongyan so different. This year, the Emperor had even canceled the March Selection, yet he had personally issued a decree for the Xi family.

---

chapters.title: What Expression Did She Have When She Entered the Palace?
chapters.content:
Song Helan suddenly recalled the day of the Flower Festival.

Gao Yi had placed a wooden slip in her hand, saying that the Emperor liked the poem.

She understood the implication.

She had taken a glance at it—though it seemed ordinary, she had still chosen it, thinking it might catch the Emperor’s eye.

Now, thinking back, everything had traces to follow.

The Emperor, who had never attended the Flower Festival, had gone that day without a word.

The Emperor, who had never concerned himself with such matters, had ordered Gao Yi to prepare the bestowed wine.

Xi Rongyan’s entry into the palace might have been arranged by the Emperor long ago, secretly and with great care.

Those below were still discussing, and as the Empress, she had to maintain control.

In truth, her informants had already reported to her that Xi Rongyan had not come because she had been summoned by the Empress Dowager. Soon, the Empress Dowager would send word.

It wasn’t a big deal for Xi Rongyan to visit the Empress Dowager first. The Empress Dowager was above her, and she should show filial piety. There was nothing wrong with this.

But at this moment, she didn’t want to explain to those people that Xi Rongyan had gone to the Empress Dowager.

She merely sighed and said gently and tolerantly to those below, "Consort Xi is entering the palace for the first time. It’s fine if she’s a little late."

"From now on, you are all sisters. Treat each other well."

"Take good care of her."

"Since she hasn’t arrived yet, you don’t need to wait. You may leave."

Those below had been hoping the Empress would punish Xi Rongyan, but they hadn’t expected the Empress to let it slide so lightly.

Xi Rongyan had the Empress Dowager’s backing, but the Empress had accompanied the Emperor for seven years, following him from the north into the capital. No woman in the harem should compare to that bond.

Moreover, Xi Rongyan had dared to slight the Empress without a word—this was already a crime.

Additionally, Xi Rongyan’s sudden appearance made them feel a hint of threat.

Because they had heard that Gao Yi himself had gone to welcome her. They understood what that implied.

Their expressions varied, but on the surface, they all obeyed and withdrew respectfully.

After leaving, they couldn’t help but whisper among themselves.

Noble Consort Ling remained until the end. After everyone else had left, she approached the Empress and called out, "Elder Cousin."

Song Helan glanced at Noble Consort Ling, maintaining her calm and composed demeanor. "Let’s not speak of this matter."

Noble Consort Ling was taken aback and still didn’t understand. She asked, "Elder Cousin, why did you arrange for Xi Rongyan to live in the Hanyuan Palace?"

"Even the Empress Dowager shouldn’t interfere in His Majesty’s harem affairs."

Song Helan sighed, a hint of bitterness in her eyes.

The Emperor, who had never interfered in harem matters, had broken all rules and etiquette for Xi Rongyan.

She, the Empress who held the phoenix seal of the harem, seemed like a joke.

She looked at Song Ningyu and slowly said, "In the future, don’t provoke Xi Rongyan."

Song Ningyu was startled and felt a little indignant. "What’s there to provoke? She’s just the Empress Dowager’s niece. What’s so great about her?"

"My father and uncle are still guarding the sixteen northern prefectures."

"That’s the most crucial place for defending against Northern Yan."

"Moreover, in the harem, only you, Elder Cousin, have given birth to a prince. Who would dare disrespect you?"

Song Helan slightly furrowed her brows, her eyes containing a warning as she looked at Song Ningyu. "Listen to me. Many things don’t require us to take action."

As she spoke, her usually calm eyes slightly narrowed, a coldness in their depths. "Let’s wait and see."

Song Ningyu pouted.

In her eyes, Xi Rongyan was not worth mentioning.

Over the past three years, the Emperor’s visits to the harem had been few and far between, and the most frequented place was still her elder cousin’s.

Among so many women, only her elder cousin had given birth to a prince.

Although the Emperor hadn’t yet named a crown prince, it was only a matter of time.

Xi Rongyan was just someone the Empress Dowager had forced in. Now she was receiving some special treatment, but it was only because the Emperor was giving face to the Empress Dowager.

Perhaps she wouldn’t even be as favored as Wang Xiuyi.

In the future, she would still have to lower her head and tuck her tail between her legs in front of her elder cousin.

Actually, thinking about this, Song Ningyu felt a little angry.

Years ago, when her elder cousin married the Emperor, her father had later betrothed her to the Emperor as a concubine. She had thought she could stand beside that heroic and handsome man, just like her elder cousin.

But in five long years of torment, she had never once caught his eye.

She gradually realized that she would probably never gain the Emperor’s affection. She could only rely on her elder cousin to have a place in the harem.

She also knew that her elder cousin was more scheming and capable than her. Their interests were aligned, so she only needed to listen to her elder cousin.

She leaned closer to the Empress again, still feeling a little resentful. "The Emperor never visits me. Elder Cousin, at least let me have a child in the future."

"I don’t expect much. Even a princess would be fine."

Song Helan looked down at Song Ningyu and silently patted her shoulder. "Don’t rush. Take it slow."

Song Ningyu was stunned. Every time she brought this up, her elder cousin said not to rush. But how many more years would she have to wait?

She still felt some resentment but didn’t dare say anything more.

---

In the Xuanzheng Hall, Wei Qi’s tall figure leaned back in his chair. A beam of light from the large window fell on the corner of his dark dragon robe, the golden thread faintly visible.

His cold eyes slightly shifted, and the nearby Gao Yi trembled, immediately kneeling to plead for forgiveness. "This servant didn’t know that Consort Xi would stay with Her Majesty the Empress Dowager for so long. This servant didn’t dare to forcibly take her away from Her Majesty the Empress Dowager."

Who knew that the Emperor would suddenly decide to have lunch with Consort Xi? If he had said so earlier, Consort Xi would definitely be waiting in the Hanyuan Palace.

Wei Qi coldly pressed his lips, his hand supporting his forehead. In the unusually quiet hall, he suddenly asked in a low voice, "What expression did she have when she entered the palace?"

As he asked, Wei Qi closed his eyes, but in his mind, he saw Xi Rongyan kneeling on the ground with tears in her eyes, her hair dusted with snow.

She had kept begging him to let her go.

No matter how he tried to coax her, it didn’t work.

Being gentle and kind to her didn’t work. Being harsh to her didn’t work either.

Her eyes only held her child and her deceased husband.

He was not a patient man, yet he had made countless concessions for her.

He fell back into his thoughts, his expression growing darker.

Then he heard Gao Yi’s cautious voice: "Consort Xi cried for a while when she first got into the palanquin, unwilling to leave her family. But once she entered the palace and saw His Majesty’s thoughtful arrangements, her face was filled with joy."

"She also said she loved peach blossoms the most, and she liked the decorations very much. This servant could see that Consort Xi understood His Majesty’s intentions."

As soon as Gao Yi finished speaking, a low, cold scoff came from above. He felt a chill down his spine and immediately kowtowed, waiting for the Emperor’s punishment.

He wished he could slap himself. He deserved it for talking too much. The Emperor must have already known the answer in his heart.

But then there was a long silence.

After what felt like an eternity, the low voice came again: "How long did she cry?"

Gao Yi was taken aback, then quickly replied, "Only for a while in the palanquin. She stopped crying once she entered the palace."

"This servant thinks Consort Xi must have cried because she was unwilling to leave her family."

Wei Qi pressed his lips together.

He understood. Xi Rongyan still didn’t want to enter the palace.

He had returned too late.

If only he had been a little earlier...

chapters.title: I Know, I Do Not Blame You
chapters.content:
Xi Rongyan left the Empress Dowager’s place in the afternoon.

Now, she was in a hurry to go to the Empress’s place.

As she walked along the palace path, she slightly lowered her head, thinking about what her aunt had told her.

Her aunt said that the noble families were gradually declining, and the Emperor wanted to take power away from them. She said it was good for Xi Rongyan to enter the palace.

No one knew when the sword hanging above would fall on the Xi family. She was told to fight for more favor.

In the Emperor’s harem, many of the women were daughters of his old subordinates from the northern lands. In the three years since his ascension, the harem had not taken in many new concubines.

As long as she gave birth to a child, the Empress Dowager would find a way to support her child as the crown prince.

Xi Rongyan knew that the Empress had a prince who was not yet six years old. The Empress and the Emperor were married by the previous emperor’s decree, and she had been by his side since they were young. In the harem, she was the only one with a prince.

Today, her aunt had tightly held her hand and earnestly told her that in the harem, one could not preserve oneself by simply staying out of trouble.

The Empress would not remain in her position forever.

Whoever’s son became the crown prince would be the ultimate winner.

She understood her aunt’s meaning.

As soon as she gave birth to a prince, the struggle would begin.

Even if she did not fight for it, others would.

She was so lost in thought that she did not notice the palanquin approaching from the opposite direction.

It was not until she heard a cold, icy hum that she came back to her senses.

Looking up, she saw a woman in the palanquin wearing a dark green dress, her hair adorned with pearl hairpins, and a swaying buyao. She had a bewitching face, bright red lips, and was looking at her with cold and somewhat contemptuous eyes.

Then, the woman’s gaze swept up and down, and she spoke with a hint of ridicule: “Which palace are you from? You have quite the air about you, daring to ignore me.”

Xi Rongyan did not know who this woman was. Fortunately, when she left, she had brought a palace servant from the Hanyuan Hall. The servant hurriedly whispered a few words in Xi Rongyan’s ear.

The woman in the palanquin was Consort Xian.

The Empress’s own cousin.

The third daughter of the Zhongyong Marquis’s second branch.

She was several years older than Xi Rongyan and had entered the Emperor’s harem long ago. Although they were both in the capital, they had not had much contact.

Now, according to rank, Xi Rongyan should indeed pay respects to Consort Xian.

Thinking that she had indeed been neglectful, and knowing the palace rules were strict, she also intended to pay respects and apologize. But Consort Xian suddenly stepped down from the palanquin and stood in front of Xi Rongyan.

Consort Xian was tall, with her chin held high. She looked at Xi Rongyan with a nearly contemptuous gaze, then pinched her chin disdainfully with her fingers, her voice mocking: “Tsk tsk, look at this weak and delicate, fox-like appearance. Do you think that by scheming your way into the palace, you can gain the Emperor’s favor? How dare you ignore the Empress.”

“Today, I will teach you a lesson on behalf of the Empress.”

The fingers on her chin were heavy, and the long nails dug into Xi Rongyan’s skin, causing her complexion to change slightly.

She knew that the Zhongyong Marquis’s family was now at its peak, deeply favored by the Emperor, and had been by the Emperor’s side since he was still a prince.

Today, the Empress Dowager had told her that when the former Crown Prince had been in trouble, the Xi family and some other noble families had worked hard to protect the Crown Prince, and had even belittled the current Emperor, who was then the Third Prince. The Emperor might not have forgotten this.

Now, the Song family’s eldest branch was defending the border, each member having achieved merit and fame. The Empress was the legitimate daughter of the Song family’s eldest branch, so the Song family indeed had the capital to be domineering.

Moreover, if it came to reasoning, the palace rules were strict. She had not yet fully understood the rules of the harem, and the Empress might not side with her. Besides, Consort Xian’s rank was higher than her own.

Xi Rongyan’s mind went back and forth several times. Then she saw Consort Xian’s finger, which was covered with a finger sheath, suddenly rise. The sharp finger sheath would surely leave two blood marks if it scratched her face.

Yuzhu and Baozhu, who were standing behind Xi Rongyan, also had their expressions change drastically. They had not expected Consort Xian to actually lay a hand on her.

Xi Rongyan looked at the hand coming down and unconsciously thought of the Empress Dowager’s words.

In the harem, there was no such thing as peace and harmony among sisters.

If the tree wants to be still, the wind will not stop. From the first day she entered the palace, she might have become a thorn in others’ eyes.

For the past three years, the harem had been almost entirely under the control of the Song family. Newcomers, in order to preserve themselves, would quickly align themselves with the Song family. Otherwise, they would be framed and suppressed.

Everyone knew she was the Empress Dowager’s niece, which made her a target for everyone.

Now, Xi Rongyan personally understood this.

The force on her chin was too strong, and Xi Rongyan could not just let Consort Xian hit her.

She raised her hand to block Consort Xian’s arm and spoke urgently: “Just now, I did not intentionally ignore Consort Xian. Whether or not Consort Xian’s actions are in accordance with the palace rules, can you at least allow me to explain?”

Song Ningyu had not expected Xi Rongyan to dare to block her. She let out a cold laugh: “Today, the Empress sent for you, but you ignored her and did not go. Is this not a serious offense?”

“My cousin is kind and does not hold it against you, but I cannot stand it and must teach you a lesson.”

With that, she ordered the palace servants behind her: “Hold her hands down.”

Baozhu’s expression changed, and seeing that Consort Xian’s hand was about to strike, she quickly stepped in front of Xi Rongyan. Her face was then scratched by the finger sheath, leaving a cut.

Gao Yi, who was at the front, saw this scene and was greatly startled. He hurriedly ran over and shouted: “Stop!”

Song Ningyu heard Gao Yi’s voice and was stunned. She turned her head and saw Gao Yi rushing over, and behind him, the Emperor, whose face showed no emotion, was walking over.

Her heart skipped a beat, and she quickly ordered her people to release Xi Rongyan and step aside.

Gao Yi saw the scene and his heart really tightened.

Just a moment ago, the Emperor had learned that Consort Xi had left the Empress Dowager’s place, and then he came over to arrange a chance encounter. Who would have thought they would encounter this situation.

He quickly went to Xi Rongyan and asked: “Consort Xi, are you alright?”

Song Ningyu saw this and her expression changed.

Although she was not favored in the palace, her status was still high, and no one in the harem had received much favor.

The Empress was her cousin, and Gao Yi usually treated her with some courtesy.

But now, Gao Yi had come over and directly stood in front of Xi Rongyan to inquire, without even looking at her.

She widened her eyes, and from the corner of her eye, she saw the Emperor approaching. She immediately threw herself at the Emperor, crying: “Your Majesty, please do me justice.”

“Consort Xi not only ignored me, but today, when the Empress sent someone to summon her, she also ignored the Empress’s order and has not gone even now.”

“Relying on being the Empress Dowager’s niece, she does not even put the Empress in her eyes.”

“Your Majesty, you…”

As she spoke, she looked up and saw the Emperor’s cold, emotionless eyes. Her voice suddenly stopped.

She was so scared that she trembled, her hand shook, and her body involuntarily took a few steps back.

She had seen the Emperor’s cruelty many times. His coldness made her usually not dare to act coy.

At this moment, she felt chilled all over.

In the harem, no woman dared to be presumptuous in front of the Emperor to seek favor. Even her cousin, the Empress, was careful around the Emperor.

Xi Rongyan heard Song Ningyu’s accusation and her heart tightened. She knew that the Song family dominated the harem, perhaps with the Emperor’s indulgence.

But she could not allow herself to be wronged.

She was about to kneel and explain, but before she could, her body was pulled into a warm embrace.

When Xi Rongyan came to her senses, she saw a dark chest before her.

A large hand pressed against her lower back, and a deep yet gentle voice sounded above her head: “It’s alright.”

Xi Rongyan was stunned. She looked up blankly, only to meet a pair of gentle eyes.

The Emperor’s usually sharp and imposing eyes now looked exceptionally gentle.

She even felt that the Emperor was gentle.

Her elder brother and father had said that the Emperor was absolutely not a gentle person, and told her to strictly adhere to the rules.

She was lost in thought, opened her mouth, and was about to explain: “This subject did not intentionally neglect the Empress. When the Empress sent someone, the Empress Dowager…”

Before she could finish, she heard the Emperor say softly: “I know, I do not blame you.”

---

chapters.title: I Will Stay in Hanyuan Hall Tonight
chapters.content:
Xi Rongyan’s heart inexplicably skipped a beat.

Then, she felt her body lighten, and she was actually lifted into the Emperor’s arms.

This scene stunned everyone present.

Song Ningyu’s face was filled with terror.

Because she knew best how cold the Emperor was.

No matter how she tried to please the Emperor, he was always cold and stern, as if no one had ever caught his icy gaze.

That man had always been indifferent.

To everyone.

She had tried countless times to please him, but even approaching the Emperor’s side made her feel cold.

Now, the Emperor was actually holding a newly entered Consort Xi in front of so many people.

She felt a bit unsteady, staring at the scene in a daze, with an indescribable pain in her heart.

Xi Rongyan had not expected this either.

Her face was slightly pale, and her fingers awkwardly rested on the Emperor’s shoulder. Her lips were slightly parted, clearly somewhat panicked.

Wei Qi saw this and pursed his lips. His deep eyes looked at Xi Rongyan, seeing the panic in her eyes, the jade earrings hidden in her black hair, and knew she was still afraid of him.

He softened his voice: “I will carry you back.”

Xi Rongyan did not even know how to respond. But when the Emperor really carried her away, she tightly clutched the handkerchief in her hand, feeling uneasy.

In front of so many people, she was still embarrassingly shy. She slightly lowered her head and buried it in the Emperor’s shoulder. Her body moved slightly, and her voice was so soft it was almost inaudible: “This subject…”

“This subject can walk.”

The light pink skirt hem swayed over the dragon robe, and the white embroidered shoes shyly revealed their pointed tips.

The fair nape of her neck exuded a faint fragrance, delicate and soft like a spring rain. Wei Qi looked down and, like coaxing a not-so-obedient kitten, said: “Don’t move.”

But on Wei Qi’s noble and distant face, which Xi Rongyan could not see, his expression was icy. His cold, long eyes glanced at Song Ningyu, who was stupidly watching the scene, and then at Gao Yi, before carrying Xi Rongyan away.

Gao Yi naturally understood the Emperor’s meaning.

The Emperor had always been someone who did not show his emotions to others. His joy and anger were always hard to fathom. Now, he was holding Consort Xi dearly in public, which clearly meant something. Gao Yi understood it in his heart.

The Emperor was telling all the women in the harem that Consort Xi was now the apple of his eye. They should not harbor bad intentions toward her.

Whoever dared to harm Consort Xi, today’s Consort Xian would be the first warning.

After the Emperor took Consort Xi away, Gao Yi calmly looked at Consort Xian, who was still shocked and terrified. With the same coldness as Wei Qi, he said: “Consort Xian has acted improperly in the harem and offended His Majesty. From today onward, she is to be confined in Huayang Palace and receive ten cane strikes.”

Song Ningyu looked at Gao Yi in terror. After realizing what was happening, she quickly knelt on the ground. The buyao in her hair swayed violently as she cried and begged for mercy: “Eunuch Gao, this concubine wants to see His Majesty.”

“Clearly, it was Consort Xi who offended this concubine. This concubine is a Consort Xian, what is she, Consort Xi?! Why should this concubine be punished?!”

Gao Yi’s face remained indifferent. He took a step back and ordered the guards behind him to cover Song Ningyu’s mouth and drag her away.

The Consort Xi, who was being held in the Emperor’s arms, vaguely heard loud crying from behind. She could not help but move slightly, trying to turn her head to look, but her waist was suddenly pinched by the fingers above her.

She was flustered by this intimate gesture, knowing that those eyes were looking at her. But she did not dare to look up, feeling uneasy. From just now until this moment, she felt as if she were in a daze.

Her nose was filled with the Emperor’s scent. Unlike the faint and elegant fragrance on her cousin Yu Yu, which always soothed her restless heart, the Emperor’s scent always made her heart flutter and at a loss.

That scent was aggressively invasive, as if it wanted to envelop her entirely.

Wei Qi looked down at the half of Xi Rongyan’s face that was buried in his arms. Her closed eyes trembled, and there was a hint of red at the corner of her eyes. Her fingers were tightly clenched. He silently suppressed his emotions.

For the latter half of the journey, at Xi Rongyan’s careful and timid request, Wei Qi finally put her down.

He held her hand as they walked along the palace path, both silent.

Xi Rongyan was cautiously silent, not knowing what to say to the Emperor.

Wei Qi wanted to speak, but he was not good at idle chat. After thinking for a long time, he glanced at Xi Rongyan’s slightly lowered, delicate eyebrows and chose not to say anything.

This stretch of the path was especially torturous for Xi Rongyan. After thinking for a long time, she finally gathered her courage and explained what had happened earlier.

Wei Qi responded with a soft “mm,” but said nothing else.

Xi Rongyan was unsure of the Emperor’s intentions and softly said: “This subject has not yet seen the Empress since entering the palace. It is indeed time to pay respects to the Empress.”

Wei Qi’s fingertips rubbed against Xi Rongyan’s soft palm, and only then did he speak: “I have already sent someone to inform the Empress. You have just entered the palace and must be tired. It can wait until tomorrow.”

After saying this, Wei Qi looked down at Xi Rongyan and saw her uneasy expression, as if she wanted to say something but hesitated. She looked like a startled, delicate sparrow, and he slightly lifted the corner of his mouth.

Soon, they arrived at Hanyuan Hall. Wei Qi stood at the door but did not go in. Instead, he gently brushed his fingers over Xi Rongyan’s delicate face, looking at her picturesque eyebrows and eyes, which were lowered shyly. This made his heart fill with tenderness.

He could not help but recall the moment when she had resolutely held a dagger to her own throat.

That woman, who had always been timid, obedient, and weak, could be so stubborn and heart-wrenching when she truly stood her ground.

He stopped his thoughts and placed his hand around her soft, slender waist. He slightly bent down, his deep and ambiguous gaze drawing near. His voice had unconsciously turned hoarse: “I will stay in Hanyuan Hall tonight.”

These few words made Xi Rongyan’s heart toss and turn like waves.

But she did not dare to show it on her face. She was about to express her gratitude for the Emperor’s favor in a flustered manner.

However, the hand on her waist pressed her against the chest in front of her. She felt a hand gently comforting her on her back. The voice above her head was gentle and lingering: “Don’t be afraid. Just wait for me calmly.”

The Emperor’s voice was so gentle that Xi Rongyan could not help but wonder why people outside thought he was cruel.

In her distraction, she saw the Emperor’s silent eyes, then watched as he left. His back was tall and straight on the palace path, growing farther and farther away.

chapters.title: Shall We Retire Now?
chapters.content:
As soon as Wei Qi returned to Xuanzheng Hall, Gao Yi immediately brought up the matter of the Virtuous Consort.

Wei Qi stood with his hands behind his back, gazing out the window in silence. After a long while, he coldly ordered, "Move her to Yanqiu Hall, strip her title, demote her to Zhao Yi, and forbid anyone from visiting her."

Gao Yi was taken aback.

Sending her to Yanqiu Hall was practically the same as banishing her to the Cold Palace!

Just then, a report came from outside the hall—there was a letter from the northern frontier.

These days, the northern frontier was at war, and letters arrived frequently. The court was abuzz with discussions about the northern battles.

Wei Qi had once fought in the north for many years, reclaiming seven cities. Now, seated on the throne, he still had to defend and expand the empire’s borders.

Gao Yi glanced at the emperor’s expression and hurried out to retrieve the letter.

Inside the Hanyuan Hall, Xi Rongyan sat in the inner chamber and pulled Baozhu over, her eyes red as she examined the bruise on Baozhu’s cheek.

Seeing Xi Rongyan’s distress, Baozhu quickly reassured her, "Mistress, I’m fine. Just now, Eunuch Gao gave me a bottle of medicine. He said it won’t take long to heal."

Xi Rongyan looked at the medicine bottle in Baozhu’s hand, her eyes still tinged with sadness. "This is only the beginning."

Yuzhu, standing nearby, tried to comfort her. "As long as Mistress doesn’t make any mistakes, just as Her Majesty the Empress Dowager said, if the Emperor has summoned Mistress into the palace, he must surely favor her."

"Win the Emperor’s heart, and everything else will fall into place."

Outside the window, shadows overlapped, and the incense burner’s smoke curled around the carved beams. Behind layers of sheer curtains, the figure of a woman in delicate makeup sat upright and proper, her white handkerchief clutched tightly in her fingers.

Pink hibiscus flowers adorned the layered folds of her skirt, and the jade hairpin in her dark hair was translucent. One hand resting on a small table, Xi Rongyan closed her eyes, recalling the words her aunt had said before she left.

Her aunt had said that once she entered the palace, she could only harden her heart and press on—there was no escape.

The emperor’s favor might fade easily, but the women of the harem competed for glory, for a promising prince to rely on, for a secure old age, for a position so unshakable that they could watch new arrivals with indifference.

She sat in confusion for a long time before remembering the peach blossom hairpin her cousin Yu Yu had given her.

It was a hairpin he had carved himself, stroke by stroke.

She stood and went to the vanity, taking the peach blossom hairpin from its case. She gazed at its warm, translucent jade, shimmering in the light, and only then did her heart gradually settle.

By nightfall, the sky had just darkened when Yuzhu, with a serious expression, pulled Xi Rongyan aside and earnestly instructed her. She handed her a book and whispered, "Mistress, you must read this carefully. Don’t be afraid later."

"The Emperor may seem cold, but I think he must truly favor Mistress."

"Mistress only needs to relax a little, endure it, and it will pass."

Yuzhu sighed, bending down to look at Xi Rongyan’s nervous eyes. "I’ve already inquired. The Emperor only visits the harem once or twice a month. This is a rare opportunity, Mistress must seize it."

"If you don’t serve him well tonight, it will be hard to get another chance like this."

"Even if Her Majesty helps you, you must also strive on your own."

Xi Rongyan felt as if she were bound and roasted over a fire, completely unable to control her own fate.

Even if she was terrified, she couldn’t willfully say she was afraid.

She clutched the book Yuzhu had given her tightly. Her mother had already shown her its contents before, but now, as she read it again, her nervous and shy palms were sweating.

Her slender fingertips pressed on a page of the book. Yuzhu patiently taught her, "In truth, men also like women to take the initiative. At the critical moment, if Mistress is a little more proactive, perhaps the Emperor will like it."

A pink blush spread to her earlobes. She looked up at Yuzhu, her eyes tense. "Yuzhu, I—"

Yuzhu saw Xi Rongyan’s nervousness and bent down, placing a hand on her shoulder. She whispered, "Mistress, don’t be afraid. Just remember what I taught you. You’re perfect in every way, just a little timid."

"As long as you’re not afraid later, the Emperor will surely like you."

Xi Rongyan’s face under the lamp glowed softly, her delicate eyebrows slightly furrowed. The beauty carried a natural air of softness and shyness, so much so that even Yuzhu was dazzled. She couldn’t believe the Emperor wouldn’t pity or like her.

Just then, Baozhu rushed in, flustered. As soon as she entered, she said, "A eunuch just came with a message—the Emperor will be here soon."

"We must go greet the Emperor."

Yuzhu nodded, carefully adjusting Xi Rongyan’s appearance before whispering a few more instructions. Then she supported Xi Rongyan as they went out.

Xi Rongyan was standing at the palace gate when the Emperor arrived.

The palace lanterns on both sides cast flickering light on the Emperor’s face. As the sedan chair was set down, the dark figure approached her, like a vast black net, enclosing her entirely.

A sudden, inexplicable fear surged within her, as if she had experienced this scene countless times before, each time filled with terror.

The towering figure came closer and closer, yet she instinctively took a step back.

Realizing what she had done, her face paled.

Wei Qi also suddenly stopped. He reached out to take Xi Rongyan’s hand, but his own hand paused as well.

In the night, he looked into her familiar, fearful, and uneasy eyes, suppressing the anger and gloom that threatened to surface.

He didn’t understand—why was she still afraid of him?

The night wind rustled her clothes. Wei Qi took a deep breath and walked closer to her.

He didn’t blame her. Seeing her nervously lift her eyes, he lowered his head with a smile, as if to soothe her unease. Then he took her hand and led her inside, asking in a very gentle voice, "Was the afternoon meal to your taste?"

Xi Rongyan quickly followed the Emperor, replying softly, "It was, Your Majesty."

And indeed, it had been.

To her surprise, every dish served had been one she used to enjoy. When she saw them at noon, she didn’t know if it was a coincidence or not, but even the flavors were exactly as she liked.

Wei Qi smiled again and directly led Xi Rongyan into the inner chamber.

He guided Xi Rongyan to sit on the arhat bed, and the palace attendants discreetly retreated behind the curtains.

Baozhu, nervous, peeked through the thin curtain at the scene inside, even more anxious than if she were serving the Emperor herself.

The two of them sat close together, their robes touching, and her hand was still held in the Emperor’s. Xi Rongyan was tense.

The last time they met, she had been nervous too, but she knew she would soon return home. Now, in a daze, she had become one of the Emperor’s consorts. Even though Yuzhu had taught her many things, her mind was now a blank.

She didn’t even dare to lift her head to meet the Emperor’s gaze. She could only pretend to be calm and pour tea for him, carefully presenting the cup. "Your Majesty, please have some tea."

Wei Qi raised an eyebrow, watching the fingertips above the white porcelain. He saw all her tension and unease. He took the cup but set it aside.

This action startled Xi Rongyan. She thought she had not served him well, or that the tea was not to his taste.

But the Empress Dowager had said the Emperor liked Mingxue tea, and Yuzhu had prepared it specially. Could there have been another mistake?

She was about to apologize when, in the next moment, a hand settled on her waist, pulling her into the Emperor’s embrace, seating her on his lap.

Behind the gauze curtain, Baozhu saw this and a delighted smile spread across her face.

It seemed the Emperor truly favored her mistress—he had hugged her as soon as he sat down.

She finally let out a sigh of relief.

Beside her, Yuzhu watched Xi Rongyan’s still restrained movements, her face filled with worry. She feared that such restraint might displease the Emperor.

Wei Qi’s gaze swept over the two figures peeking from behind the curtain, then lowered to the person in his arms.

He met her anxious eyes, his gaze slowly traveling from her delicate nose down to her full lips.

His expression darkened, and his chest pressed a little closer to her. His gaze returned to her eyes, his Adam’s apple bobbing as he spoke in a low voice, "Shall we retire now?"

---

chapters.title: Attending the Emperor
chapters.content:
Xi Rongyan had just been startled by the Emperor’s actions, and now his question left her stunned again.

The Emperor’s tone made it sound as if he were asking for her opinion.

This was completely different from what she had imagined.

She hadn’t expected the Emperor to ask her.

After a blank moment of thought, she nodded absentmindedly. Of course, she didn’t dare to defy the Emperor’s wishes. "Then this concubine will help Your Majesty change clothes."

As she spoke, Xi Rongyan tried to rise from the Emperor’s lap.

But the hand around her waist showed no sign of letting go. She only saw the Emperor’s dark eyes fixed intently on her, and then he spoke in a low voice, "If you are afraid, I can hold you and do nothing."

Xi Rongyan was stunned once more.

The Emperor was nothing like the one she had imagined, nor like the one she had heard about from the Empress Dowager.

The Emperor actually cared about her feelings. He actually cared if she was afraid.

Wei Qi watched Xi Rongyan’s expression closely. He gently patted her back, pressing her small, delicate body against his chest, and soothed her in a tender voice, "I know you’re afraid, Yan’er. I won’t force you."

A strange feeling filled Xi Rongyan’s heart. She was at a loss, yet the Emperor’s words were gentle and soothing. For a moment, this Emperor reminded her of her cousin, Yu Yu.

The Emperor called her Yan’er, just as her cousin Yu Yu used to call her Little Yan.

Her chin rested against the Emperor’s broad shoulder, her fingers resting on his waist. She understood that after entering the palace, she had to face reality. She had her family behind her; she couldn’t afford to be willful.

Xi Rongyan closed her eyes and softly said, "This concubine is not afraid."

The delicate jade earrings brushed against Wei Qi’s jaw. He silently pressed his lips together, then pulled the person in his arms even closer.

Her soft body and lingering fragrance were just as he remembered, making him want to pull her into his very being.

But he restrained himself, suppressing his desire for her.

He recalled the first time he had taken her.

She had cried bitterly.

With what little strength she had, she had struck his chest.

Her nails were not long, trimmed round and soft. Even when they scratched his face, it didn’t hurt.

But she had struggled fiercely.

She had cried and refused to cooperate.

In the end, he had been angry, tying her wrists to the bedpost and venting his frustration on her.

But she had kept crying out in pain, tears streaming endlessly from her soft eyes. The more he saw and heard, the angrier he became.

How could someone who had already borne a child keep crying out in pain?

She simply didn’t want to be with him. She didn’t want him to touch her.

Her cries of pain felt like an insult to his dignity.

He had used even more force, punishing her as if punishing himself.

After that time, every time she saw him, she was filled with fear.

Later, when he saw the blood on her lips from biting, he realized she had truly been in pain.

Only then did he learn that the women in his harem, who didn’t dare to cry out in pain, had also suffered.

He had never before considered a woman’s feelings. He knew neither the so-called art of love nor that he was different from ordinary men.

But now, he didn’t want Xi Rongyan to reject him again.

Having learned his lesson, he would wait patiently until she was willing to accept him.

He also knew that the first time was especially difficult for a woman. Though he feared Xi Rongyan’s resistance, he was even more afraid of failing to give her a good experience, just as in his past life, when neither of them had ever found pleasure.

Now, as long as she slowly accepted him in her heart, that would be enough.

After all, he was now her first man.

Wei Qi carried Xi Rongyan toward the bed but didn’t let her undress him. He bent down and gently caressed her face, his voice low and hoarse. "You and I are like an ordinary husband and wife. You need not fear me."

"No matter what you do, I won’t blame you."

"Even in the imperial palace, you can do anything freely."

Xi Rongyan was lost in the Emperor’s words—"ordinary husband and wife"—and couldn’t recover her senses.

Why would the Emperor say such things to her?

She nervously twisted her sleeve but didn’t dare to respond.

She and the Emperor were far from being like a husband and wife. If she agreed, wouldn’t that imply she was coveting the Empress’s position?

Wei Qi saw that Xi Rongyan was still silent, just staring at him blankly, as if she couldn’t process his words.

He knew she wouldn’t believe him now, but it didn’t matter. They had plenty of time.

She would believe him one day.

Wei Qi lowered his gaze, cupping her face, his thumb brushing against her lips. His dark eyes locked onto the eyes he had longed for day and night. Inside, his emotions were in turmoil.

He wanted to kiss her lips.

Even though he knew she would no longer look at him with hatred or resistance, he still asked cautiously, "May I kiss you?"

Xi Rongyan felt as if she were drowning in the Emperor’s gentle yet profound gaze. Her cheeks began to burn, and she nodded lightly, though her fingers nervously twisted together.

The moment Xi Rongyan nodded, Wei Qi could no longer wait. He lowered his waist and pried open her lips, his movements slightly urgent, like a conqueror storming a city.

But when he heard her soft moan, he forced himself to stop.

He saw her delicate eyebrows furrow, as if she didn’t enjoy it.

Wei Qi understood—he still couldn’t hide his desire for her.

The emotion of losing her and then regaining her made him unable to control himself.

He lowered his gaze, covering Xi Rongyan’s eyes with his hand. His scorching gaze roamed freely over her, but his movements were much gentler.

The palace attendants outside knew what was happening inside and tactfully lowered the curtains.

It was only the hour of Xu, and the Emperor had arrived and carried their mistress to the bed. They hadn’t expected this either.

Baozhu was nervous. Though she couldn’t see inside, she curiously listened for sounds.

She only heard a few faint moans, vague and indistinct, and couldn’t make out what was happening inside.

On the bed in the inner chamber, Xi Rongyan’s clothes were already in disarray, pressed beneath the Emperor. She was kissed until she was dizzy, her eyes filled with a misty sheen. The man before her was blurred, except for his eyes, which were both unfamiliar and familiar.

Those eyes, when they looked at her, seemed cold, yet also full of deep affection.

She couldn’t tell which it was. She only felt her body go limp, and then the Emperor’s hoarse voice reached her ears, "Do you like this, Yan’er?"

Xi Rongyan couldn’t answer.

She was forced to tilt her head back, her lips parted, unable to close. She felt as if she were floating on clouds, her body no longer her own.

She only remembered that the man before her was the Emperor.

She remembered the instructions from the Empress Dowager and Yuzhu.

She had to be accommodating and take the initiative.

Her fingers weakly hooked onto the Emperor’s robe, and she nodded weakly, unable to distinguish between like and willingness.

Wei Qi’s body was already tense, his forehead beaded with sweat, yet he endured, pulling the limp figure into his arms.

No matter how obedient and gentle the person in his arms was, he still saw a trace of panic in her half-closed, dazed eyes.

Apart from kissing, he did nothing else. He was more patient than before. He didn’t want to lose her again.

Clothes were already scattered on the floor beside the bed. It was late at night, and Xi Rongyan was half-asleep, her face buried in Wei Qi’s chest, unable to open her eyes.

Wei Qi tightly gripped her soft waist, looking at her peaceful sleeping face nestled in his arms. Only then did his eyes reveal a possessive gleam as he pressed her even closer to him.

The next morning, when Xi Rongyan woke, she felt the arm around her waist holding her so tightly that she could barely breathe.

A lazy, hoarse voice came from behind her, "Awake?"

Xi Rongyan’s mind went blank for a moment before she hummed in response. The hand around her waist tightened, turning her over.

When she came to her senses, she was faced with a solid, broad chest, completely exposed before her eyes.

It was the first time she had seen a man so bare. She stared blankly for a long time before belatedly looking up, only to meet the Emperor’s deep, dark gaze.

chapters.title: Delight
chapters.content:
Though those eyes showed no emotion, they seemed to hold a hint of a smile.

Yet even with that hint of a smile, the sharp brows beneath them did not make him look any gentler.

Her cheeks felt warm. She propped herself up. "This concubine will help Your Majesty dress."

Most of her hair fell over one side of her shoulder. Her fingers pressed against the bed beside him, her bright eyes fixed on him. Her fair face, framed by the white garment, was delicate and smooth, her collar as proper and careful as she was.

Wei Qi looked at her, his fingers pressing against her waist before pushing her back into his embrace with a bit more force.

The fingers that had often held a sword bore a thin layer of calluses, and the sensation against Xi Rongyan's smooth skin was undeniable.

He reached out to rub her fair earlobe, his gaze unwavering as he stared into her still naive and confused eyes, feeling her soft body pressed against his chest.

This was the first time they had shared such tender affection.

She did not resist him anymore.

What he had long yearned for, when finally obtained, felt like this.

He only wished this moment could last a little longer.

His hand rested on her back, his fingers lingering on the shy warmth of her body before he asked softly, "Did you sleep well last night?"

At the mention of last night, Xi Rongyan couldn't help but recall how the Emperor had kissed her the night before.

She had been kissed until she was dizzy, not even knowing how she had fallen asleep.

Her cheeks burned again. She bit her lip, not daring to meet the Emperor's eyes, and when she lowered her gaze, she saw his bare chest.

The warmth radiating from his chest left her flustered. She was too shy to think too much and quickly nodded slightly.

The crimson lips pressed by her pearly teeth left a faint red mark. Wei Qi couldn't help but swallow, knowing how soft those lips were.

His gaze darkened, and the hand around her tightened.

Just then, Gao Yi's voice came from outside, reminding them. Wei Qi took a deep breath, only lowering his head to kiss her forehead before letting her go and getting up from the bed.

He looked at Xi Rongyan, who was trying to get up as well, and bent down to press on her shoulder. "You sleep a little longer."

With that, he straightened up and walked out from behind the screen, letting the palace attendants outside come in to help him dress.

Xi Rongyan was still sitting on the bed, lost in thought as she watched the figure dressing behind the screen. Suddenly, she remembered she should help with his attire.

She quickly stood up and went out.

When Wei Qi saw Xi Rongyan approaching, and noticed her thin clothing, her quiet and delicate figure under the lamp seemed frail. He reached out to pull her into his embrace, kissed the top of her head, and sighed.

In the end, he was greedy for her scent. The moment she came to him, his heart was truly filled with joy.

He also longed for her to take the initiative to come closer.

Xi Rongyan had never taken the initiative to approach him before.

His outer garments were almost fully on. A palace maid beside him held a tray containing the Emperor's jade pendant and sachet. Xi Rongyan took them, intending to kneel and help the Emperor put them on.

Her body was still held by the Emperor. He looked down at her. "Just put it on for me like this."

Xi Rongyan looked into the Emperor's gentle eyes. Under the warm lamp, the Emperor seemed less sharp, his fierce brows softened. It turned out the Emperor was this gentle in private.

Her heart skipped a beat. She bent down carefully to fasten the jade ornament for the Emperor.

The occasional touches at his waist made Wei Qi tense up again. Having restrained himself all night without touching her, now seeing her take the initiative to fasten his jade pendant, and noticing the red marks he had left on her fair neck, he felt an almost novice-like infatuation with the pleasures of intimacy.

His fingers, unable to resist, fell on her lowered face. The real and soft touch made him slowly exhale.

Gao Yi, waiting outside, had never seen the Emperor stay in any palace chamber this long, not even in the Queen's palace.

Then he heard the call for water and was startled again.

The Emperor had never stayed in a consort's palace to freshen up. Even if he stayed overnight, he would dress and leave early in the morning.

Although the Emperor rarely stayed overnight in the harem, this time truly surprised Gao Yi. He felt that Xi Zhao Yi must not be neglected.

Inside the hall, Wei Qi did not let Xi Rongyan see him off. Instead, seeing the blush on her cheeks, it seemed she was no longer as afraid of him. He turned around with a hint of a smile on his face.

When Gao Yi saw that smile on Wei Qi's face, he was even more shocked, as if he had seen a ghost.

Since he started serving the Emperor, he had rarely seen the Emperor smile.

As soon as the Emperor left, Yu Zhu and Bao Zhu hurried in.

Seeing Xi Rongyan still sitting on the bed in a daze, Yu Zhu happily said, "This servant knew that the mistress could do it."

Xi Rongyan was silent for a moment. She still felt a bit dizzy and collapsed back onto the bed, hugging the brocade quilt. She felt lazy and suddenly looked up at Bao Zhu's face, seeing that the swelling had gone down, before closing her eyes again.

Yu Zhu saw Xi Rongyan's lazy appearance and gently asked, "Mistress, did you... last night?"

Xi Rongyan buried her face deeper, knowing what Yu Zhu was asking. She felt her eartips burning and softly said, "No..."

Yu Zhu didn't understand what Xi Rongyan meant. She coaxed her softly for a while before helping her up to wash and dress.

While Bao Zhu was tidying the bed, she searched for a long time but couldn't find what she was looking for. After a long pause, she stumbled out, "Mistress, on the bed..."

Xi Rongyan understood what Bao Zhu meant. She turned her head to look at Bao Zhu and calmly said, "The Emperor did not touch me last night."

Yu Zhu and Bao Zhu were both shocked.

Yu Zhu's expression changed. She had just glimpsed through the curtains earlier that the Emperor had held the mistress for a long time in the morning, which didn't seem like he hadn't been served well.

Xi Rongyan didn't know what to say. She recalled the Emperor's words from last night. Had the Emperor noticed her fear and was taking care of her?

In truth, although she had been a little afraid last night, she had also been prepared. But the Emperor had been unexpectedly gentle, which she hadn't anticipated.

Yu Zhu saw Xi Rongyan lost in thought, her gaze falling on the red marks on Xi Rongyan's fair neck, clearly left by someone's bite. She couldn't understand how, having gone this far, they hadn't proceeded to the final step.

In the end, she couldn't bear to say anything. She knew that although her mistress was reserved, she understood the situation and had her own considerations.

She told Bao Zhu to bring some makeup powder and covered the red marks on Xi Rongyan's neck.

---

chapters.title: Last Night's Hardship
chapters.content:
When she finished preparing and went to Yongchun Palace, as soon as Xi Rongyan entered, she felt everyone's gaze on her.

Those gazes, as she glanced over them, were not very friendly.

She ignored those stares without showing any reaction and properly greeted the Empress with a respectful curtsy.

Song Helan sat upright in the highest seat, her demeanor elegant, her expression toward Xi Rongyan unreadable.

She had heard of Xi Rongyan before—the Empress Dowager's beloved niece, often summoned into the palace, and with an excellent reputation among the noble ladies.

She had seen her before—a beauty unmatched among thousands, someone who inspired both jealousy and admiration.

Her previous two engagements had both been excellent matches, yet both had ended in misfortune.

She slightly lowered her eyes, looking at the person bowing before her, modest and unadorned.

She wore a smoke-gauze dress of apricot blossom color, the collar embroidered with blue cloud patterns, wide floral sleeves, a slender and graceful waist. Her hair was adorned with only two silver hairpins inlaid with jade and pearl blossoms, standing out elegantly against her black hair.

Her face was as fair as a pear blossom, her downcast eyes like misty pearl clouds, exuding a quiet and proper demeanor without the slightest hint of arrogance or restlessness.

On the contrary, her naturally elegant willow-leaf eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes, and cherry-like crimson lips, combined with her soft voice, gave her a delicate and weak appearance that most attracted men's affection.

She was both similar to and different from the Xi Rongyan Song Helan had imagined.

She understood that the long-balanced harem could no longer remain balanced.

Yesterday's incident was a warning from the Emperor—no one was allowed to touch Xi Rongyan.

Yesterday afternoon, when she went to see the Emperor, he wouldn't even grant her an audience. It was the Emperor's usual coldness toward her, so cold that she could only find some solace in her position as Empress.

Song Helan's face showed a composed and dignified smile. She spoke softly to Xi Rongyan, "Zhao Yi Xi, you must be exhausted from attending to the Emperor all night. Please rise."

She then ordered the matron beside her to grant Xi Rongyan a seat, placing her in the foremost position.

This arrangement made everyone's gaze focus even more intently on Xi Rongyan.

They saw her graceful and quiet figure, holding a lotus-shaped fan properly on her lap, her back straight, a circle of white pearl necklace around her neck complementing the jade earrings. Anyone who saw her would be stunned.

This fair and serene demeanor, elegant and well-bred, made her seem like a celestial being untouched by worldly concerns, making everyone else seem mundane in comparison.

Song Helan noticed everyone's gazes and spoke softly to Xi Rongyan, "Yesterday, Xian Fei offended you. I hope you won't hold a grudge."

"Let this matter pass."

Everyone's expressions showed surprise again.

They had all heard about yesterday's incident—how Xian Fei had bumped into Xi Rongyan on the road, but Xi Rongyan had ignored Xian Fei, relying on the Empress Dowager's support and showing disdain for everyone.

As a result, the two had a conflict, and the Emperor had actually taken Xi Rongyan's side.

Why was that?

According to the rules, it was Xi Rongyan who had been discourteous first. Why was Xian Fei the one punished?

Moreover, Xian Fei had the Empress's backing. Was Xi Rongyan really so arrogant?

First ignoring the Empress, then ignoring Xian Fei?

They whispered among themselves, feeling something was amiss. But since Xian Fei wasn't present today, and hearing the Empress speak like this, it seemed the matter was indeed settled.

Then they thought about how the Emperor had stayed the entire night in Hanyuan Palace, and a subconscious jealousy made them look at Xi Rongyan with an additional layer of scrutiny and disdain.

She might appear modest and detached, but deep down, she was a vixen skilled at acting to gain sympathy.

Xi Rongyan naturally sensed the unfriendly gazes around her. The Empress's words had undoubtedly pushed her into the spotlight again, and her words clearly favored Xian Fei.

She understood the Empress's attitude toward her and calmly stood up, respectfully addressing the Empress, "Yesterday's incident happened because of a misunderstanding between this concubine and Xian Fei."

"The Empress Dowager summoned this concubine yesterday to speak, and also sent someone to inform Her Majesty the Empress. Xian Fei did not have time to listen to this concubine's explanation before laying hands on her. This concubine did not take offense and has already explained everything to His Majesty. This matter is already settled in this concubine's heart and should be considered past. I will not hold a grudge."

In truth, Xi Rongyan didn't want to make a fuss. She had intended to clarify yesterday's events with Xian Fei in front of the Empress today and then let the matter drop.

Although she had gone to see the Empress Dowager first, it couldn't be considered neglecting the Empress, since the Empress Dowager had been the one to summon her first. The Empress had no reason to accuse her of neglect.

But she had just noticed that Xian Fei wasn't present, and hearing the Empress bring it up, she knew the relationship between the Empress and Xian Fei. She spoke to clarify and prevent others from misinterpreting.

Song Helan looked at Xi Rongyan, a faint, almost imperceptible cold smile on her lips.

She appeared gentle and quiet, but she was quite eloquent.

She truly wasn't as simple as she seemed.

How had the Emperor punished Xian Fei yesterday? For such a minor matter, the Emperor had been so severe. Song Helan didn't believe that Xi Rongyan hadn't added fuel to the fire.

Song Helan's gaze dimmed slightly, and she spoke softly again, "You need not explain any misunderstandings to me. Since the Emperor has taken your side, then it must be that Xian Fei was in the wrong."

"The Emperor has already punished Xian Fei. I bring this up only to tell you that harmony in the harem is the most important thing."

As she spoke, Song Helan's face bore an indistinct, emotionless smile. "Those minor misunderstandings and conflicts can be clarified here with me in private. There's no need to make a big scene out of them."

"Don't you agree?"

"Now that the Emperor favors you, the others in the palace will naturally be happy for you and won't compete with you. You should also remain calm and composed."

No matter how one listened, these words carried another layer of meaning.

It was as if Xi Rongyan had stirred up trouble to vie for favor or to flaunt the Emperor's affection.

Moreover, this was the first Xi Rongyan had heard that Xian Fei had been punished by the Emperor.

She saw how the others' expressions changed after the Empress's words, clearly influenced by her. Xi Rongyan pondered for a moment and was about to speak when the Empress cut her off, "Zhao Yi Xi, take your seat first. I have another announcement to make."

The Empress then smiled and said, "Early this morning, High Eunuch Gao came to say that starting today, Zhao Yi Xi's position will be elevated to that of a Pin. The Emperor has specially bestowed the character 'Zhen' upon her. From now on, she will be known as Zhen Pin."

"Don't forget how to address her from now on."

The others present exchanged glances, their faces showing shock as they looked at Xi Rongyan.

She had only stayed overnight once, and her position was immediately elevated.

It was already rare to be granted the title of Zhao Yi upon entering the palace, and now she was a Pin. In a few more days, wouldn't she be a Fei?

They had heard that Xian Fei's title had been revoked, leaving a vacancy among the four consorts...

Wang Xiu Yi watched the scene, then looked at Xi Rongyan's dignified and proper posture, her eyes filled with complex emotions.

The person beside her nudged her and said with a smile, "Speaking of which, before this, the most favored in the harem was you, sister. You've been in the palace for three years, and even with the Emperor's favor, you're still just a Xiu Yi."

"She's only been here for a day, and after one night with the Emperor, her rank is already higher than yours."

"Truly, different people have different fates."

"What do you think, sister?"

Wang Xiu Yi's expression froze. She glanced at the person beside her and tightened her grip.

Xi Rongyan naturally heard the whispers. Her face remained calm and unmoved.

She realized that the Empress intended to make her the target of everyone's resentment.

Then someone laughed and said, "Zhen Pin is truly fortunate. Her childhood betrothed just died, and so quickly she has gained the Emperor's favor. Which of you has a fate as good as Zhen Pin's?"

Xi Rongyan paused, her fingers tightening.

A cold laugh came from below. "Isn't that right? She's outlived two fiancés. If she hadn't entered the palace, I hear she couldn't even find a marriage."

"Look at Zhen Pin, she doesn't seem heartbroken at all. It turns out she had caught the Emperor's eye."

The voice then asked Xi Rongyan with a smile, "Zhen Pin, when you frequently entered the palace before to see the Empress Dowager, did you often see the Emperor as well?"

Below, someone laughed, suppressing their voice but still clearly audible to Xi Rongyan. "I heard she used to come to the palace very often before. Who knows what she was planning?"

"That Lord Gu was such a gentleman and treated her so well. Who would have thought she'd look down on him?"

chapters.title: He Treats Her Differently
chapters.content:
Xi Rongyan’s fingers, gripping the fan handle, turned white as she looked at the speaker.

A palace maid quickly whispered a sentence into Xi Rongyan’s ear.

The speaker was Qi Fei, Lu Rongyue.

She was also a former subordinate of the Emperor.

Qi Fei’s eyes held a smile. She wasn’t particularly beautiful, but she exuded a calm demeanor. Yet, her words were far from kind.

Xi Rongyan studied her carefully, a slight frown between her brows. “When I first entered the palace, it was to keep the Empress Dowager company. Nothing more.”

“As for past matters, I do not wish to speak of them. But if one judges without knowing the full story, then may I also speak recklessly about you, sister?”

Lu Rongyue let out a cold snort, about to speak, when the Empress above suddenly furrowed her brows and interrupted, “My original intention was to have you all live in harmony. Why bring up such things?”

“It is a good thing that Zhen Pin has the Emperor’s favor. She can also soon bear children for the Emperor.”

“From now on, do not speak of these matters again.”

The Empress then turned to Xi Rongyan. “If anyone in the future disrespects you against palace rules, you need not report it to the Emperor. Tell me, and I will handle it.”

She then coldly glanced at everyone. “Xian Fei has already been demoted to Zhao Yi by the Emperor and confined to the Yanqiu Palace. Have you not learned your lesson?”

The Empress’s words seemed to be defending Xi Rongyan, but the underlying meaning was that Xi Rongyan had slandered others before the Emperor, using his favor to suppress the other concubines.

Xi Rongyan now understood everything. The Empress was not as fair and kind as people said.
