Sure enough, the Empress first politely and warmly invited her to sit beside her, then began inquiring about Consort Xian.

Xi Rongyan respectfully replied, "This concubine has not yet had the chance to speak of Consort Xian's matters."

A casual, drawn-out voice responded, "Oh?"

The Empress fiddled with her long golden finger sheaths, then looked at Xi Rongyan with a faint smile. "It seems Zhenpin had a tiring night attending to His Majesty."

Xi Rongyan lifted her head and replied, "His Majesty came to bathe last night and then went to sleep. This concubine did not dare disturb him."

In truth, Xi Rongyan didn't care much about whether to plead for leniency or not. First, His Majesty's decision wasn't due to her instigation, and the punishment was so severe that she vaguely felt it wasn't just about that day's incident—there might be other hidden reasons. She had no need to change His Majesty's mind.

Second, even if she did plead, if Consort Xian was spared, all would be well. But if not, the Empress would think she hadn't tried hard enough, leaving her in a difficult position either way.

She might as well speak openly.

Song Helan hadn't expected Xi Rongyan to be so direct. She studied her for a moment, a cold glint flashing in her eyes before quickly warming her tone again. "I was just asking casually, nothing more."

"You and Consort Xie have a relationship like mine with Consort Xian. I was merely a little concerned."

As she spoke, Song Helan took a box from a palace maid beside her, opened it, and took out an exquisitely carved gold and jade bracelet, which she placed on Xi Rongyan's wrist. She smiled and said, "You are the first to receive His Majesty's favor for two consecutive nights. This is your fortune, and I am happy for you."

"This bracelet is a token of my sincerity. I hope you will soon bear a prince for His Majesty, adding to the joy."

Xi Rongyan looked at the bracelet on her wrist, her mind too preoccupied to think much. She quickly stood and thanked the Empress.

Song Helan helped Xi Rongyan up and examined her with a smile. "I have troubled you with Consort Xian's matters. I know His Majesty's punishment of her is justified. You need not take it to heart."

"Even if you are unwilling to plead for her, I won't blame you."

"This matter is settled. I won’t ask you about her again. It’s her own fortune."

The Empress’s attitude today was somewhat different from yesterday. Xi Rongyan pondered this for a moment before hurriedly expressing her gratitude again.

After leaving the Empress, as soon as she returned, Yuzhu urgently had Xi Rongyan remove the bracelet.

Xi Rongyan knew Yuzhu was worried the bracelet might be tampered with, but recalling the Empress’s kind and gracious demeanor in public, she thought the Empress’s mind was not so shallow as to resort to such obvious tactics.

Yuzhu thought for a moment and said, "My lady, you’ve just entered the palace and already gained favor. Do you think the Empress would truly wish for you to bear a prince?"

"As far as this servant knows, His Majesty is now twenty-five. Though the number of women in the harem isn’t small, it shouldn’t be so difficult to have an heir."

Even without Yuzhu’s words, Xi Rongyan hadn’t intended to wear the bracelet. She took it off and had Yuzhu put it away carefully.

Meanwhile, in Yongchun Palace, Empress Song summoned Consort Qi, Consort Li, and Consort Hui.

Consort Qi spoke first, "Your Majesty, are you going to allow her to remain so favored?"

"His Majesty only visits the harem a few times a year. If this continues, what if she bears a dragon son in the future, and His Majesty..."

She didn’t dare finish the sentence, but her words were sincere.

They had never been favored by His Majesty since following him, but they knew their interests were tied to the Empress’s. If the Empress fell, they would suffer the same fate.

Consort Hui chimed in, "This concubine has never seen His Majesty favor any woman so much. When His Majesty was still a prince in the northern lands, it was understandable that he didn’t favor anyone. But now that he has ascended the throne for three years, how many women in the harem struggle even to see him once?"

"What virtue or ability does Zhenpin have to make His Majesty so devoted? Isn’t it just some fox spirit sorcery?"

"If His Majesty is truly bewitched, and the Empress Dowager pushes from behind, won’t her tail be held high in triumph?"

"By then, she might not even show you respect."

Empress Song’s fingertips tapped on the table, her posture straight. The golden light from the phoenix hairpin on her head made her usually gentle face appear slightly cold.

His Majesty had broken precedent by visiting her yesterday. Though his words were casual, she had heard the warning in them.

It was still about Xi Rongyan.

She glanced at Consort Hui and said coolly, "You need not say these things in front of me. His Majesty specifically arranged for her to stay in Hanyuan Hall, with all her needs managed by Eunuch Gao. What is the purpose of this, if not to prevent her from being wronged?"

"His Majesty may have seen all your actions. Remember what I told you yesterday: do not act recklessly, and treat Zhenpin well in public."

"Consort Xian is His Majesty’s warning to you and me. Do not think His Majesty is easy to deceive. Xi Rongyan is not like the other women who entered the palace through the selection process."

"His Majesty doesn’t care about those women and rarely visits the harem, so you could bully them. But Xi Rongyan was brought into the palace by His Majesty’s decree through Gao Yi. Don’t you understand? Under His Majesty’s watchful eyes, we cannot touch her."

Consort Li looked at the Empress and asked, "Then what should we do? Just watch her gain favor?"

Empress Song gave her a sidelong glance and coldly smiled, "We won’t act, but what about others?"

"For example, Wang Xiuyi, who once received His Majesty’s favor."

As she spoke, Empress Song’s face broke into another cold smile. "And Xi Rongyan’s cousin, Xie Yumian."

Consort Qi was taken aback and looked at Empress Song. "Consort Xie probably won’t do anything."

"I’ve heard they were very close before, and their families are relatives. She probably won’t act against her."

Empress Song smiled. "The closer people were before, the more complex their feelings become when they see the other gaining more favor."

"Just wait. His Majesty will only favor that woman more and more. How will she feel compared to Consort Xie, like a joke?"

"What must it feel like for her good sister to be the apple of His Majesty’s eye, while she gets nothing, not even a scrap?"

"His Majesty is not the type to look at Xie Yumian just because he favors Zhenpin."

Consort Qi still had some concerns. "But previously, I..."

Empress Song raised an eyebrow. "That doesn’t matter. We can slowly win her over now."

"Plant a few seeds of discord in front of her. Over time, even the deepest feelings can crack."

As she spoke, Empress Song smiled again. "Moreover, I can see clearly that Xie Yumian wants His Majesty’s favor more than anyone."

"Previously, when Wang Xiuyi was favored, Xie Yumian was already jealous of her. How much more so now that it’s her close sister, Zhenpin?"

Consort Hui, who had been silent all along, nodded. "You’re right, Your Majesty. When His Majesty was still a prince, though he didn’t interfere in harem affairs, whenever something happened, he saw through it all. Back then, no one dared to cause trouble or vie for favor."

"It’s difficult to deceive His Majesty, so it’s best we don’t act."

"When the time comes that we have no choice, it won’t be too late to act."

"Let those so-called refined and elegant noblewomen fight among themselves. Isn’t it better for us to watch the show?"

Consort Li silently watched the others before nodding in agreement.

---

chapters.title: Love Incense
chapters.content:
In the afternoon, Xi Rongyan was summoned by the Empress Dowager.

The Empress Dowager, knowing that His Majesty had stayed with her for two consecutive nights, looked very pleased.

She handed a box to Xi Rongyan and smiled, "It is your fortune that His Majesty favors you so. I have never seen His Majesty so devoted to anyone before."

"This box contains Qi-Xue pills. Take one each day; it will help you conceive."

Xi Rongyan opened the box and saw red pills inside, each emitting a faint medicinal fragrance.

She understood that the Empress Dowager wanted her to conceive quickly, and it was for her own good.

The Empress Dowager then looked at Xi Rongyan’s simple attire and, holding her hand, asked, "Why are you dressed so plainly?"

Xi Rongyan looked up. "This niece has only just entered the palace and does not wish to stand out."

She then lowered her voice, "Now that His Majesty often visits my quarters, it is better to keep a low profile."

The Empress Dowager paused, then smiled. "Don’t always think about keeping a low profile. Your opportunity is here."

"You’ve only been in the palace for two days, yet you’ve already surpassed others who have been here for two years."

"Take your cousin, for example. His Majesty has never favored her."

This was the first time Xi Rongyan had heard this.

Her cousin had never spoken to her about her relationship with His Majesty in the palace, so she was indeed surprised.

She hesitated, "How could that be..."

The Empress Dowager smiled. "Do you think His Majesty favors every woman in the harem?"

"Many never even catch a glimpse of His Majesty and grow old and die in the harem."

"Those with low ranks don’t even have the right to pay respects to the Empress."

"In the past, women schemed to encounter His Majesty by chance, but none of them ended well."

The incense from the censer on the side table curled lazily in the quiet room. The Empress Dowager stirred her teacup slowly, then looked at Xi Rongyan’s eyes. "Rongyan, His Majesty’s favor upon you is your fortune."

"You mother wrote to me about what happened during the Flower Festival. Do you think His Majesty would have decreed your entry into the palace if he hadn’t taken a liking to you?"

"Given His Majesty’s temperament, if you had offended him, he would have punished you."

Xi Rongyan suddenly recalled what His Majesty had told her that morning—that he had long admired her.

In truth, she found it somewhat incredible.

His Majesty had left for the northern lands at fifteen, establishing many military achievements. He had rarely returned to the capital, only coming back when the late emperor fell seriously ill at twenty-one. It had only been a little over three years since then, and the two of them had truly met only a few times.

Even when they did meet, it was merely casual greetings.

Before her thoughts could settle, the Empress Dowager dismissed her attendants, took another box from a small table beside her, and handed a bracelet to Xi Rongyan. She lowered her voice, "This bracelet is hollow inside. It contains 'Joyous Love Incense.'"

"When His Majesty comes, wear it on your hand. He will surely not be able to leave you."

Xi Rongyan looked at the object and felt a sense of unease.

The Empress Dowager frowned. "Yan’er, your aunt has been in the harem for so many years. She has experienced every kind of scheme."

"His Majesty is also a man, and men have desires."

"You are only amplifying that desire. Once you have a child, you won’t need it anymore."

"A man’s love is fleeting. If you don’t seize this opportunity, you may never get another chance."

"Your aunt relied on this to conceive. Do you trust your aunt? Would I harm you?"

Xi Rongyan looked at the bracelet in the Empress Dowager’s hand, her heart torn with hesitation.

She had entered the palace to live peacefully, but she didn’t want to use such methods.

His Majesty didn’t seem like the type to indulge in lust, and given his diligence in governance, he spent little time in the harem. If he found out she was using such a thing, it might backfire.

But after much hesitation, she still took it in her hand.

She would accept the Empress Dowager’s goodwill and put her mind at ease.

After returning, Xi Rongyan examined the bracelet in her room. She held it to her nose and sniffed—it truly had a fragrance.

Indescribable, yet pleasant, and not easily noticeable.

Baozhu curiously asked, "Is it really that magical?"

Yuzhu looked at Xi Rongyan and asked, "The Empress Dowager’s gift should be effective. If His Majesty comes again tonight, why not try it?"

Xi Rongyan, however, placed the bracelet in Yuzhu’s hand and shook her head. "Put it away in the box. I don’t want to use this."

Yuzhu had no choice but to say, "Since you’ve entered the palace, my lady, you should at least consider your future."

Xi Rongyan sat on the luohan bed, turned her head toward Yuzhu, and softly said, "I know you both mean well, but I don’t want to use such methods. I fear it might backfire."

"It’s not that dire yet."

Yuzhu paused, then took the bracelet away to store it.

Xi Rongyan then called Baozhu to check the injury on her face. There was still a faint pink mark, but fortunately, it was fading. She finally felt a little relieved.

In the evening, His Majesty came again. Xi Rongyan had just finished bathing. She usually went to bed early and, after checking the time, thought His Majesty wouldn’t come tonight, so she lay down on the bed.

She had been propping herself up on her elbow, talking to Baozhu, when she heard the news that His Majesty had arrived. Her heart skipped a beat. Before she could sit up properly, His Majesty’s tall figure had already strode into the room.

Baozhu, knowing better, quickly excused herself.

His Majesty still carried the chill of the night air, and though the room was warm, his dark-clad figure made Xi Rongyan feel a sudden coolness.

Emperor Wei Qi’s gaze swept over Xi Rongyan’s wrist, silently lowering his eyes before embracing her tightly, feeling the warmth of her body.

Xi Rongyan felt that as His Majesty held her, he seemed to know she might be cold, so he pulled the blanket that had slipped to her waist up a little higher.

His warm palm already rested on her back.

Now, even His Majesty’s scent was familiar to her. She was no longer as afraid of him as before. She hadn’t expected His Majesty to come tonight, and hearing his soft sighs by her ear, she lifted her head.

She saw that His Majesty was also looking at her. In his somewhat cold and clear eyes, there was candlelight, and her reflection.

She wanted to take the initiative but didn’t know how.

Even now, with His Majesty holding her so gently, she didn’t understand how she should react.

After a moment of hesitation, she lightly leaned into His Majesty’s embrace, the only initiative she could manage.

Wei Qi hadn’t expected Xi Rongyan to take the initiative. Now, her soft body had actually leaned into him.

His heart pounded wildly, and the fingers he had placed behind her trembled with excitement.

Suddenly, he cupped Xi Rongyan’s face, gazing at her quietly. The excitement in his eyes flickered in the candlelight.

The earrings by her ears tapped against the ring on his finger, the fine, crisp sound like a seductive note. Her fair, moon-like face was no longer a reflection in the water but a real touch in his hands.

He could no longer restrain himself. Under that pair of clear eyes, he lowered his head and kissed her.

The fragrance from her body made his body tense, and the soft touch made his long-suppressed blood boil. He pressed her against him, his hands uncontrollably roaming over her body.

chapters.title: Did I Frighten You Just Now?
chapters.content:
Wei Qi kissed her deeply, so much that Xi Rongyan could barely close her lips. She let out soft whimpers from the discomfort but did not stop him.

His large hand slid under her clothes, the coolness from his cuffs making her shiver slightly.

She knew what might happen soon.

Earlier, Yuzhu had even made her carefully read a small booklet, which was still under her pillow now.

She also knew it would hurt. Her mother had said to endure it for a while, and it would pass. Every woman went through this pain, and it would get better afterward.

Xi Rongyan was afraid, and the emperor’s movements were urgent and heavy. Her mouth ached too, but she thought, If I endure it for a bit, it will pass.

She didn’t dare open her eyes. When the emperor finally released her lips and tongue, she heard his suppressed, heavy breathing beside her ear.

Just like in her dream.

The man in her dream had been the same.

With the same heavy force.

A flicker of fear rose in her again.

She cautiously opened her eyes just a little, only to meet the emperor’s gaze as he looked at her.

Those dark eyes were bottomless, tinged with desire, making them appear somewhat ferocious and terrifying. For a moment, they were identical to the eyes of the man in her dream.

In the dream, that man had restrained her hands, making her whole body ache with endless torment.

She couldn’t tell dream from reality and instinctively cried out, “Don’t…”

Wei Qi froze, his hand halting mid-motion as he removed his outer robe.

He abruptly snapped out of his boiling desire and saw Xi Rongyan’s terrified eyes.

Just moments ago, she had been so compliant beneath him, her fingers even gently resting on his waist.

He had thought she was ready, ready to give herself to him.

So why was she looking at him with such fear now?

He instinctively glanced at the distorted reflection on the nearby lamp stand. He had thought he had hidden all his possessiveness well, but the reflection was warped, like a monstrous demon—even he couldn’t clearly see himself in it.

The fingers gripping Xi Rongyan’s waist were already bulging with veins, yet Wei Qi lowered his gaze, burying all his dark emotions in the shadows.

His half-removed outer robe hung loosely on him. He bent down and gently lifted Xi Rongyan into his arms. Looking at her fearful eyes, he didn’t blame her at all. He simply lowered his head, kissed her forehead, and softly asked, “Did I frighten you just now?”

When Xi Rongyan looked at the emperor’s eyes now, they were gentle as they regarded her. Her heart pounded, and a sudden wave of guilt surged within her.

She didn’t understand why she was haunted by such nightmares. The emperor was gentle to her, yet she had said such things just now, and the emperor hadn’t even blamed her.

Xi Rongyan quickly shook her head, then lowered her eyes in guilt, not daring to meet the emperor’s gaze. She whispered, “Just now, this concubine did not mean it…”

Wei Qi patiently soothed her, “It’s fine, I don’t blame you.”

“It was I who was too rough just now.”

As he spoke, Wei Qi lifted her chin and asked, “Did I hurt you just now?”

It had hurt a little. The emperor’s movements had been heavy.

Xi Rongyan hesitated again, but in the end, she didn’t admit it. She lightly shook her head once more. “No…”

Wei Qi had already guessed the answer from her earlier hesitation.

In truth, he knew Xi Rongyan still feared his status and didn’t dare to speak honestly. This woman had always been timid, afraid of everything.

Yet she had been so devoted to her late husband, unwilling to submit.

In the past life, she had feared him yet still defied him.

He pressed his lips together, his gaze falling on the red marks on her neck. His fingers gently lifted the side of her clothes.

There were also red marks on her waist from his earlier force.

Wei Qi was taken aback. He bent down and kissed the mark tenderly, then looked at her with guilt. “Rongyan, I’m sorry.”

“I’ll be gentler next time.”

When the emperor had kissed her waist just now, Xi Rongyan had shivered. There was still a tingling numbness there.

She seemed to recall the emperor had said he would be gentler before.

But Xi Rongyan had no experience in such matters and didn’t know if the emperor had been too rough or if this was normal.

She nodded lightly. The emperor’s fingers kneaded her waist again, such a gentle touch, yet she clearly felt his affection.

After a long while, Wei Qi had Xi Rongyan go to sleep first while he went to bathe.

Watching the emperor’s retreating figure, Xi Rongyan silently thought that tonight would probably end without consummation again.

Though she felt a little regretful, she also felt a sense of relief, as if she had escaped a great ordeal.

It was a complex mix of emotions.

She closed her eyes, only to dream again of entanglement with that man. She didn’t want to dream of him anymore and tried to stay awake to forget.

When Wei Qi returned, he was surprised to find Xi Rongyan still awake, as if she had been waiting for him.

A warmth spread in his heart. He pulled her warm body into his arms and, looking at her fair, shy face, unconsciously softened his voice. “Were you waiting for me?”

Xi Rongyan hadn’t originally intended to, but seeing the emperor’s lowered gaze, she instinctively nodded.

This obedient nod pleased Wei Qi. It was rare for her to wait for him like this—she wasn’t completely indifferent to him.

His body stirred with an uncontrollable impulse, but he restrained it, merely gently stroking her hair.

Xi Rongyan saw that the emperor seemed to be in an excellent mood. After deliberating in her mind, she finally gathered the courage to ask, “This concubine wishes for my cousin to come live together in Guanju Palace. Would Your Majesty allow it?”

This was the second time Xi Rongyan had brought this up.

Wei Qi hummed nasally, glancing at her face before wearily patting her back. “Go to sleep.”

Xi Rongyan was taken aback. The emperor’s response was unclear—she didn’t know if he had agreed or not.

After a moment of hesitation, she lifted her head and asked again, “Has Your Majesty agreed?”

Wei Qi lowered his gaze to her, pondering for a moment how to cut off her thoughts.

He didn’t want to disappoint Xi Rongyan, but he also didn’t want her cousin to come here.

Not to mention Xie Yumei’s impure intentions in the past life—he simply didn’t want Xi Rongyan to be reminded of her past with Gu Yunyu again.

If Xie Yumei came, it would inevitably stir up some memories.

He only wanted Gu Yunyu to be completely a thing of the past.

Wei Qi slightly regretted it. He had forgotten about Xie Yumei. If he had known, he should have sent her away earlier.

His fingertips moved at her waist. After a brief silence, he softly said to Xi Rongyan, “This matter will be arranged by the empress. I have already given the order.”

When Xi Rongyan heard “empress,” she knew this matter would likely be difficult. But since the emperor had already spoken, it seemed improper for her to ask again.

She knew that Qi Fei was the empress’s person and wasn’t sure if the empress would arrange it. She was just a little uncertain.

She feared that Qi Fei might make things difficult for her cousin.

She wanted to speak again, but the emperor had already reached out to lower the bed curtains. The thick fabric blocked out the outside light, and above her head, the emperor’s hoarse voice asked, “Are you used to living in the palace?”

Xi Rongyan vaguely understood that the emperor didn’t want to discuss this anymore. She had no choice but to set aside the matter of her cousin for now and softly replied, “Yes.”

The emperor seemed to have asked casually, merely humming in response before falling silent again.

Xi Rongyan, however, didn’t want to have another dream. She tossed and turned, unable to fall asleep.

In the darkness, Wei Qi opened his eyes and raised an eyebrow at the person in his arms who still wasn’t asleep. He pressed her waist to stop her from moving, and the hand under her neck pulled her over to lie against his chest. “Can’t sleep?” he asked.

Xi Rongyan half-lay on Wei Qi’s chest and softly said, “In this palace, this concubine has no one to talk to. It’s cold and lonely.”

As she spoke, Xi Rongyan, as if coquettishly, pressed her face against Wei Qi’s chest, her fingers encircling his broad, solid waist. She even rubbed against him slightly, making Wei Qi’s breath catch.

---

chapters.title: A Rare Initiative
chapters.content:
Wei Qi knew why Xi Rongyan was doing this.

It was rare for her to be so proactive.

She was simply so concerned about others.

He pressed his lips together, not speaking. Her soft body made him tense, especially since she was only wearing thin clothes. She had no idea how tempting she was being.

Perhaps she truly believed he wouldn’t touch her.

He silently lowered his gaze to her, his heart already beginning to relent. In the end, he couldn’t bear to disappoint her.

In the past life, he had wanted to indulge her when she acted coy, but she had never done so.

His fingers rested on her black hair, and he let out a soft sigh. “I will arrange it properly. Wait a few more days.”

Hearing the emperor’s words, Xi Rongyan’s somewhat anxious heart relaxed a little. She hugged the emperor tightly and whispered, “This concubine thanks Your Majesty.”

Wei Qi silently curled the corner of his lips. His fingers slid from her hair to her waist, then asked, “Is there anything else you want to say to me?”

Xi Rongyan did have something.

She brought up the matter of the Virtuous Consort that the empress had mentioned to her, then softly said, “About Virtuous Consort…”

Her voice trailed off as the emperor let out a low chuckle.

She looked up but couldn’t see the emperor’s expression in the dark. She didn’t understand why he was laughing.

She only heard his deep voice: “Even if I spare her, she won’t think it was you who pleaded for her.”

“It was I who wanted to punish her long ago. Don’t think about the Virtuous Consort’s matter anymore. I will speak to the empress.”

Xi Rongyan paused, then felt at ease.

She nodded and contentedly nestled into the emperor’s arms.

Xi Rongyan was also puzzled. The emperor always spoke to her gently, as if he never got angry. She truly wasn’t as afraid of him as before. Instead, with him by her side, she felt a sense of peace that allowed her to fall asleep.

Since she was young, her body had always been cold. Even in spring, she needed a hot water bottle in her blanket. The emperor’s body was warm, and when he held her, she wouldn’t feel cold all night.

She felt the emperor’s kiss on her forehead—gentle and warm. Her heart slowed, and the fingers around his chest tightened. She closed her eyes peacefully.

When Wei Qi woke up the next morning, Xi Rongyan was still asleep.

He watched her closed eyes buried in his arms for a long time, then lightly touched her cheek. The warm, soft sensation made everything feel real.

He couldn’t help but recall the moment she had left him, covered in blood.

Wei Qi closed his eyes, cutting off his thoughts, then gently sat up.

When Xi Rongyan suddenly awoke, she found that the emperor had already left.

Over the next few days, the emperor stayed in Hanyuan Hall.

Whispers spread through the harem, and the way people looked at Xi Rongyan changed repeatedly.

One morning, as she left the empress’s place, Xi Rongyan had intended to find her cousin to discuss the matter of her moving in. But someone suddenly blocked her path.

Xi Rongyan looked over and recognized her after a few days.

It was Wang Xiuyi, the one her mother had told her about—the most favored in the harem.

Wang Xiuyi was indeed very beautiful, graceful and refined, wearing a peach-pink spring dress with a jade bone fan in her hand. Both hands were adorned with jade bracelets, and her attire was very meticulous.

But her eyebrows were raised high, somewhat at odds with her gentle face.

Xi Rongyan also guessed some of Wang Xiuyi’s hostility toward her.

Even if Wang Xiuyi was this hostile, Xi Rongyan didn’t feel the slightest displeasure.

In the past, Wang Xiuyi had been favored. Now, perhaps it was her turn. And after her, who would it be?

If every favored person was hated in turn, could one possibly hate them all?

As youth and beauty faded, there would still be young and beautiful women entering the palace. Would the emperor still remember the old ones then?

Xi Rongyan didn’t want to invite hatred. She softly asked, “Elder Sister, do you have something to say to me?”

Wang Xiuyi looked Xi Rongyan up and down. She had seen her from afar at banquets before.

At that time, Xi Rongyan had been the focus among the noble ladies, not just because of her outstanding appearance, but also her consistently gentle and warm demeanor.

She had always been proper in her interactions with others.

Back then, even her own elder brother had secretly admired her, though it was a pity she had already been betrothed.

She had once wanted to become a woman like that and had harbored a hint of jealousy.

She still remembered a banquet where Xi Rongyan, wearing only a simple blue orchid dress, had shimmered under the sunlight. Sitting before the blooming begonia flowers, she had attracted everyone’s attention.

Now that she had entered the palace, Wang Xiuyi knew she couldn’t compare, but she still couldn’t accept it.

Previously, she had been the only one the emperor visited in the harem. Even though the emperor had never touched her when he visited, ever since Xi Rongyan entered the palace, the emperor had no longer shown any intention of coming to her, and that was what she couldn’t accept.

The sisters who had once flattered her now looked at her with faint pity. She wasn’t deaf—she could hear the sarcastic remarks.

Even Qi Fei and Hui Fei, who had been somewhat polite to her before, now ignored her.

Even the small eunuchs from the inner court, who had once fawned over her, no longer came to pay their respects.

Even her usual food had, in just a few days, become much worse than before.

Of course she was resentful.

How could she not be?

If Xi Rongyan hadn’t entered the palace, none of this would have changed.

Wang Baoran clenched her fingers tightly, her face struggling to suppress her jealousy.

The harem was like this—everyone was a master at reading the situation. Seeing that the emperor no longer visited her, they immediately changed their attitudes.

She took a deep breath and forced a smile. “I do have something to say to Younger Sister.”

“Would it be convenient for me to visit your place, Younger Sister?”

Xi Rongyan looked at her expression and nodded in agreement.

Not far behind, Qi Fei and Hui Fei watched Wang Xiuyi and Xi Rongyan walk away. Hui Fei smiled and said, “Look, I just had someone tamper with Wang Xiuyi’s food and let people mock her for a couple of days, and she can’t hold back anymore.”

Qi Fei slowly smiled. “The empress dowager really has her ways. We’ll just wait and watch the show.”

The two chuckled and turned to walk in another direction.

Xie Yumei stood not far away on the palace path, watching Xi Rongyan and Wang Xiuyi walk side by side into the distance. Her face stiffened.

She had thought Xi Rongyan would really let her go to Hanyuan Hall. The emperor had stayed with her for so many days in a row, showing her so much favor. She didn’t believe that such a request would be refused.

Or perhaps Xi Rongyan didn’t actually want to help her, fearing that if she came to Guanju Palace, she would steal the emperor’s favor.

Xie Yumei tightly clenched the handkerchief in her hand, watching Xi Rongyan’s retreating figure until it disappeared. A hint of hatred flickered in her eyes.

Wang Baoran followed Xi Rongyan to Hanyuan Hall. As her gaze swept over every part of the palace’s decor, seeing how Xi Rongyan lived alone in such a spacious palace, her jealousy surged again.

The two sat down on chairs together. Wang Baoran’s eyes reddened as she pressed a handkerchief to them and began to cry softly.

chapters.title: Increasingly Favored
chapters.content:
Xi Rongyan was taken aback at Wang Baoran's appearance, confused as to why she started crying as soon as she sat down. She quickly whispered, "What's wrong, Sister?"

Wang Baoran looked at Xi Rongyan, tears welling up as she choked out, "It's nothing, just envious of your good fortune."

Xi Rongyan didn't know what to say, only softly persuading, "Sister, there's no need to envy me. There's not much difference between you and me."

But Wang Baoran wiped her tears, "Ever since His Majesty started visiting your place, I fear he has forgotten about me, an old favorite."

Xi Rongyan sincerely advised, "How do you know I won't become the old favorite in the future?"

"Perhaps soon, His Majesty won't come to my place either."

Wang Baoran froze, staring blankly at Xi Rongyan's eyes.

She saw her sitting elegantly beside her, with not a hint of smugness from being favored. Instead, it made Wang Baoran feel like a pitiful clown who couldn't get what she wanted.

Wang Baoran, lost in thought, said, "You're joking, Sister. Who in the harem can compare to you now?"

"Everyone can see that His Majesty treats you differently."

Xi Rongyan didn't want to argue about this, only softly saying, "Sister, whether you believe it or not, what I said just now came from my heart."

Wang Baoran stared at Xi Rongyan's face again.

She couldn't see any flaw in Xi Rongyan's expression, as if His Majesty's favor truly didn't matter to her.

And she genuinely didn't want to compete.

Clearly, she had gained countless benefits from His Majesty's favor, yet now she pretended to be so indifferent. What was the point?

Wang Baoran forced herself to suppress the discomfort in her heart, dried her tears, and tightly held Xi Rongyan's hand, asking, "Sister, can I ask what method you used to make His Majesty stay at your place for several days in a row?"

As she spoke, Wang Baoran shed more tears, "I don't ask for anything else, only that His Majesty stays at my place for one night."

Xi Rongyan's hand was gripped tightly by Wang Baoran, so tight that it started to ache.

She looked at Wang Baoran's sorrowful expression, tears continuously falling, and felt a different kind of sadness in her heart.

She had long known that she would be locked up here for life, and had prepared herself to be buried among the many women.

If she couldn't be more open-minded and let herself go, she would only live in pain.

Wang Xiyu obviously hadn't let herself go.

She wondered, would she become like this in the future? Developing an obsession, unable to let go, only torturing herself.

This made her feel a new fear for the future.

Xi Rongyan felt a lump in her throat. As she lowered her head, the cold earrings brushed against her cheek, and the circle of white jade necklace around her neck swayed. She gently wiped Wang Baoran's tears with a handkerchief, knowing she couldn't help anyone.

And as for Wang Baoran's purpose in coming here, she vaguely guessed, not thinking that she truly came just for this.

Moreover, asking her what method to use to gain His Majesty's favor—was Wang Baoran too naive, or did she think Xi Rongyan had no guard against her?

She only calmly said, "Sister, don't be so sad. I truly didn't use any method. I don't understand why His Majesty comes to my place."

"You've been favored before, Sister. What can I teach you?"

"But we are both in the harem. Usually, we can talk to each other to pass the time."

The scented handkerchief gently touched Wang Baoran's eyes. She paused for a moment, and when she lowered her gaze, she saw the silver-threaded orchid-patterned fan resting on Xi Rongyan's lap.

Her gaze moved inch by inch upward, from the neat and delicate collar, to the gentle glow of the strung beads reflecting her tearful eyes, and then to the faint calmness beneath Xi Rongyan's picturesque brows.

Elegant and graceful, yet also charming and beautiful, with a slender, jade-like figure—who wouldn't like her?

It seemed not so hard to accept that His Majesty liked her.

Suddenly, she felt that she would probably never be able to compare to her.

She didn't have Xi Rongyan's good fortune. Upon entering the palace, she lived alone in a palace, without pressure from the Empress's faction, and with the Dowager Empress supporting her. Even if she lost favor, the Empress wouldn't treat her too harshly.

But she was different.

In the palace, women who didn't receive His Majesty's favor were like insignificant weeds beneath the palace walls. Even eunuchs could step on them.

They might not see His Majesty even once a year, and even if they died, they would be sent out wrapped in a white cloth.

This forced her to compete.

She also didn't have the family background and confidence that Xi Rongyan had.

A line of tears fell from Wang Baoran's eyes as she sincerely said, "I can't compare to you, Sister. How can I pass the time leisurely like you?"

"I just want to receive even a little favor from His Majesty, so I can live a little better in the palace."

Xi Rongyan looked at that line of tears, her dark eyebrows furrowing and then relaxing, silently saying, "Sister, you entered the palace earlier than me and should understand the way to survive in the harem and His Majesty's temperament. You should know that I truly can't help you."

Xi Rongyan didn't even know how to help her cousin come to live in Guan Ju Palace, let alone help Wang Baoran.

In that moment, Wang Baoran suddenly understood.

Xi Rongyan was still the gentle and refined young lady from before, whom everyone liked because she truly could nourish others like spring rain.

Even though Wang Baoran had just genuinely hated and envied her, in an instant, she suddenly stopped hating her.

She knew Xi Rongyan was right, and she also understood that His Majesty was not someone who could be controlled.

And some people were born to have everything.

Even when the Gu family had fallen into disrepute, and everyone had sneered at Xi Rongyan, she had still entered the palace effortlessly and gained His Majesty's favor without much trouble.

Suddenly, she couldn't hold back her tears and, lowering her head, leaned tightly against Xi Rongyan's shoulder, sobbing, "Can I come and talk to you often in the future?"

Xi Rongyan hadn't expected Wang Baoran to suddenly lean on her. She felt a slight dampness on her shoulder and softly said, "Of course you can. It's lonely here by myself."

In the end, as Wang Baoran left, she turned back to look at the palace full of peach blossoms.

She had heard before that Xi Rongyan liked peach blossoms. At that glance, she completely gave up hope.

Because she understood that perhaps His Majesty truly liked her, and had planted this palace full of peach blossoms for her. Perhaps she was the only one His Majesty cared about so deeply.

She didn't want to compete anymore. She even hoped that Xi Rongyan would receive more and more favor.

Between the seemingly gentle and kind Empress, who was actually cold-hearted, and Xi Rongyan, she hoped that Xi Rongyan would gain power.

At that time, the harem would probably be truly peaceful.

Wang Baoran returned to Xingqing Palace.

The main hall of Xingqing Palace was occupied by Concubine Hui, the adjacent Xiyun Hall was where Consort Lin resided, and Jingyi Xuan was where she lived alone.

The two not-so-spacious rooms were on the dimly lit west side.

She listened to the laughter of Concubine Hui and Consort Lin from the main hall, sitting coldly and quietly on a chair by the window.

The palace maid standing behind her took a step forward and asked, "Mistress, didn't you prepare things early? Why didn't you give them to Noble Consort Zhen just now?"

"If you bring down Noble Consort Zhen, His Majesty will remember you again."

Wang Baoran glanced at the palace maid beside her. There wasn't much respect in the maid's eyes; instead, there was some blame.

She remained silent.

After entering the palace, the palace maids assigned to her were all carefully arranged by the Empress. What could she say?

Every step she took was under someone else's watchful eye.

The Empress only needed a small mistake to bring her down, and it would be so easy.

Wang Baoran remained silent for a long time before softly saying, "Wait a little longer."

After Wang Baoran left, Xi Rongyan's mood also fell.

She sat on the luohan couch, side-facing the window, lost in thought as she looked at the peach blossoms outside. Her fingers toyed with the fan, and the image of Wang Baoran's tearful eyes appeared before her.

She felt a pang of sadness for her, and deep down, there was a sense of sorrow.

She propped her head on the small table, in the cold and quiet yet exquisite palace, looking at the old object her mother had given her on her wrist, as if it were her only comfort.

It reminded her of the carefree days of the past.

In Xuanzheng Hall, Wei Qi listened to Gao Yi's report that Wang Baoran had gone to Hanyuan Palace to talk to Xi Rongyan, and his fingers on the dragon desk paused.

---

chapters.title: Yan'er, Come Here
chapters.content:
Wei Qi used to visit Wang Baoran once or twice a month, not for any other reason. He had suffered some minor leg ailments from years of campaigning in his youth, which occasionally ached.

Wang Baoran was skilled in massage and could relieve his discomfort.

It wasn't that he had to go to her; it was just that Wang Baoran was quite considerate, didn't dare to talk much, and wouldn't cling or flirt, which was much better than those noisy women who sought favor.

Now, Wei Qi was worried that Wang Baoran might have said something to Xi Rongyan.

He was afraid Xi Rongyan would overthink.

After all, in the eyes of others, he had once favored Wang Baoran.

His fingertips lightly tapped the desk a few times, then he softly gave Gao Yi some instructions.

Gao Yi responded and bowed before leaving.

It was already mid-afternoon, and the sky was dark.

Xi Rongyan was summoned to Xuanzheng Hall, not knowing what it was about.

When she entered, she only saw His Majesty sitting on a high desk, with the golden dragon pillar behind him exuding authority. The white jade tiles on the floor vaguely reflected the figures, and the incense burned softly.

This was her first time here. Seeing the towering stack of memorials behind His Majesty, his golden crown gleaming, and his noble face stern, lacking the usual gentleness she saw, she quickly moved to kneel.

But His Majesty put down the memorial in his hand and beckoned to her, "Yan'er, come here."

Xi Rongyan paused in her movement but still walked to His Majesty's side.

Wei Qi pulled Xi Rongyan onto his lap, carefully examining her expression. Seeing her sitting on his lap with her head slightly lowered, not looking at him, the green jade earrings swaying lightly, it tightened his heart.

He also noticed the shadow under her long lashes, as if she was harboring some worries, and he couldn't help but hold her tighter.

He didn't want her to overthink, believing that he had liked others before.

But he didn't want to directly ask her about Wang Baoran, afraid she would think he was constantly monitoring her actions.

Wei Qi glanced at Gao Yi beside him. Gao Yi went out and beckoned to someone outside. Soon, several eunuchs entered with their heads lowered, carrying several trays.

Wei Qi beckoned one forward, pointing to the gold and silver dotted kingfisher feather fortune and happiness floral crown on the tray. He looked at Xi Rongyan's expression and softly asked, "Do you like it?"

Gao Yi watched from the side. This was something many noble consorts in the palace desired. His Majesty had never bestowed such things before, but now he had brought the most beautiful ones all at once, just to please Noble Consort Zhen.

Xi Rongyan only glanced at it. Seeing the hundred-flower crown inlaid with a circle of eastern pearls, the gold and silver dotted kingfisher feather work was exquisite. With just one look, she knew it was a luxurious item unique to the palace.

She rarely wore crowns, except for banquets or outings. Normally, she didn't wear them. She had many jewelry pieces, and at this moment, she didn't particularly like or dislike them.

But she still nodded, "I like it."

Wei Qi looked at Xi Rongyan's expression, but it didn't sit well with him.

He beckoned another person forward, presenting a pair of gold filigree inlaid gemstone peony hairpins in front of Xi Rongyan. His dark eyes were fixed on her as he softly asked again, "Do you like it?"

He thought that women always liked these things.

But in his past life, there had been a similar scene.

She had been dispirited and hadn't even glanced at the things he gave her.

Wei Qi pursed his lips, subtly observing Xi Rongyan's reaction.

He wouldn't say sweet words to please a woman. Having grown up in the desolate and cold northern lands from a young age, he hadn't had the chance for romantic experiences like his two older brothers who stayed in the capital.

He just thought that the design suited her.

In his past life, Xi Rongyan had rejected his advances because she resented him.

Now, she shouldn't resent him anymore.

In truth, it had to be said that the pair of hairpins in His Majesty's hand were indeed exquisite and beautiful. Worn in the hair, they would certainly display nobility.

Xi Rongyan lightly raised her eyes to look at His Majesty's lowered gaze, which held tenderness and a hint of deep affection.

She couldn't help but wonder, had His Majesty looked at Wang Xiyu the same way before?

Of course, she knew these thoughts weren't worth dwelling on. The harem was like this, and even her mother said ordinary households were the same.

She just sighed, realizing that when you love someone, you truly forget the previous person quickly.

Xi Rongyan gently nodded, "This concubine likes it."

Her voice was soft like an oriole's song, but Wei Qi could see that she didn't seem to like it that much.

He pursed his lips, his eyes darkening.

He gently inserted the hairpin into her raven-black hair. There was only a single flat, wide white jade hairpin that she usually wore in her hair. All the jewelry she wore was jade, and the ornate gold hairpin seemed somewhat out of place.

Wei Qi's expression darkened slightly. He only wanted to give her the best he could, but perhaps it was never what she wanted.

His heart wavered for a moment, but he quickly brushed aside that fleeting sense of frustration.

From the moment he decided to take her from the Gu family, he had stopped caring whether it was what she wanted or not.

He had the others come forward and displayed all the jewelry on the trays before her. Looking at her face, he said, "I'll have someone send all these to your palace later."

Xi Rongyan was only stunned for a moment, not understanding why His Majesty suddenly bestowed so many things upon her. She quickly rose to thank His Majesty.

Wei Qi didn't let Xi Rongyan get up from his lap. Instead, he pressed her body closer to him. After having everyone in the inner hall leave, he took a plate of rose milk pastry from his side and picked up a piece, bringing it to Xi Rongyan's lips.

His deep gaze looked at her, "Try it."

Wei Qi still remembered the time when Xi Rongyan had tried to escape, and he had locked her in the palace. During that time, she refused to eat anything, and he had to threaten her with her child before she would eat a little.

He had put in countless efforts, having people prepare food according to her preferences.

Among all the pastries, he had only seen Xi Rongyan eat a few more bites of the rose pastry, so he had remembered it.

The unique milky fragrance of the pastry blended with the rich scent of roses indeed made Xi Rongyan want to try it.

She had loved eating pastry and milk cream since she was a child.

She saw that His Majesty's eyes were always on her, and since His Majesty was feeding her himself, although she was a bit unaccustomed, she gently opened her lips and took a bite.

Seeing Xi Rongyan bite down, Wei Qi finally smiled and asked her, "Is it good?"

Xi Rongyan nodded.

It was indeed delicious—melting in the mouth, not too sweet, and very much to her taste.

She looked at the large remaining piece on His Majesty's fingertips and reached out her hand, softly saying, "Let this concubine hold it."

Wei Qi still brought the remaining piece to her lips, his movements seemingly brooking no refusal as he looked at her, "If you like it, I'll have someone deliver it to your place every day from now on."

Xi Rongyan looked at the milk pastry brought to her again, feeling a small inner struggle, but still took a bite.

She hoped to finish quickly. Sitting on His Majesty's lap and being so close to him always made her very nervous.

But as soon as she finished, His Majesty took another piece, and she quickly shook her head, "I can't eat any more."

Wei Qi raised an eyebrow, "Can't even finish one piece?"

He still brought the rose milk pastry to her lips, watching the bit of powder on her full lips, his gaze deep, "Just one more bite."

Xi Rongyan saw His Majesty's insistence and had no choice but to take another bite.

She watched helplessly as the rest was sent into His Majesty's mouth.

She felt her face heat up again.

chapters.title: I Have a Hidden Ailment
chapters.content:
The hall was dim, with a single thread of daylight streaming in, falling on her fair and delicate profile.

Wei Qi lowered his head and saw her almost translucent, pale skin, the fine down clearly visible.

He noticed her fingers nervously gripping the handle of her round fan, her nails bare of the vibrant colors other concubines painted them with—clean, round, and natural.

A section of her snow-white wrist peeked out from under her wide sleeve, adorned with a single transparent lavender bracelet, making her skin appear even more like fresh snow. He placed his hand over the back of hers.

The warm, smooth touch made him linger, and he tightened his grip, interlocking his fingers with hers.

The person in his arms seemed restless, shifting slightly. A faint, elegant fragrance wafted from her, and the pearls and jade in her hair shimmered.

Wei Qi silently lowered his gaze.

Watching Xi Rongyan, who still seemed somewhat reserved, he bent his shoulders and looked into her eyes—eyes that had barely glanced his way.

Her quiet demeanor subtly displeased him.

He remained silent for a long while, then tightened his grip on her fingertips before suddenly speaking: "I have a hidden ailment."

Xi Rongyan had been puzzled by the Emperor’s prolonged silence as he held her, and now, upon hearing his words, she couldn’t help but look up in surprise.

The Emperor said he had a hidden ailment?

Why was he telling her this now?

Xi Rongyan hesitated, unsure whether to ask further. She parted her lips, then saw the Emperor looking down at her, wondering if he wanted her to inquire.

Fortunately, she didn’t have to deliberate long—the Emperor spoke first.

"My knee was once injured, and it occasionally aches. That’s why I visited Wang Xiuyi every month."

"She knows some massage techniques that can ease the pain."

As he spoke, Wei Qi glanced at Xi Rongyan’s expression again. "Now, I won’t be going to her anymore."

Xi Rongyan froze for a moment, still not understanding why the Emperor had brought this up.

She hesitated before asking, "Why won’t Your Majesty go anymore?"

Wei Qi looked at Xi Rongyan again. "The imperial physician has already treated me."

Xi Rongyan was taken aback.

She looked up at the Emperor. Did he mean that all his past visits to Wang Xiuyi were only for her massages, and now that he was healed, he wouldn’t go anymore?

Why was the Emperor specifically telling her this?

Moreover, the harem had long whispered that the Emperor favored Wang Xiuyi deeply. Even if it was only for his leg injury, after such a long time, surely there must be some affection—how could he simply stop going?

Perhaps this was also why they said the Emperor was cold-hearted.

She recalled how Wang Xiuyi had wept so bitterly in front of her earlier.

Perhaps Wang Xiuyi had once believed the Emperor felt differently about her.

But in the Emperor’s eyes, it was not so.

No wonder her aunt and mother had both warned her: the Emperor’s favor was like fireworks—fleeting. In the harem, women rose and fell, and no one was ever truly special.

One must never harbor such expectations.

Otherwise, life in the harem would be an endless torment.

Fortunately, Xi Rongyan truly felt no sorrow. She had never believed she would be the special one.

She blinked, then nodded, lowering her head to look at the Emperor’s hand still holding hers, suddenly at a loss for words.

Her mind was a whirl of thoughts, her aunt’s warnings echoing in her ears.

They kept her painfully aware of her place.

Wei Qi silently watched Xi Rongyan. His explanation seemed to have done little to bring a smile to her face.

A familiar sense of insecurity from his past life surged within him.

Suddenly, he lifted her into his arms. The abrupt movement startled Xi Rongyan, and her fingers instinctively clenched his robes before she realized she had been swept up.

After her initial shock, she asked in confusion, "Where is Your Majesty taking this concubine?"

Wei Qi looked deeply into her eyes, his lips pressed together. For the first time, he didn’t answer her, simply carrying her in silence toward the inner resting chamber.

He placed her on his bed, then quickly pressed his body down over hers.

Outside, the sky was still bright, not yet dark. Xi Rongyan felt a flicker of panic, then saw the Emperor’s dark eyes fixed intently on her. She wondered—was he going to... now?

In truth, she had already prepared herself. If the Emperor truly wanted to...

It was bound to happen sooner or later.

And Wei Qi truly did want to.

Just as in his past life, whenever he faced uncertainty with her, he would crave her body.

The more she resisted, the more he desired her.

Now, Wei Qi felt a hint of frustration. He didn’t want her to misunderstand his feelings for Wang Xiuyi, but his explanation seemed to have no effect.

When he had placed her on the bed, his movements hadn’t been particularly gentle. The golden hairpin in her hair had slipped out, falling beside the pillow, and the wide jade hairpin was loosely tangled in her dark hair.

Her white jade earrings had also fallen into her hair, and the fragrance from her body seemed to taunt him endlessly.

There was a beast within him, one he kept tightly leashed when facing Xi Rongyan. But there were times when it threatened to break free.

In his mind, images flashed—her current flushed, timid beauty, and the pale, tear-streaked face she had worn in the past.

Finally, his mind settled on that snowy day when she had buried her face in his chest and coughed up blood.

Wei Qi’s eyes gradually reddened, his grip on Xi Rongyan’s wrist tightening again and again.

Xi Rongyan watched in horror as the Emperor’s eyes grew increasingly terrifying, his gaze dark and murderous, as if he might kill at any moment.

The pain in her wrist grew sharper, and in a small, trembling voice, she cried out, "Your Majesty!"

The soft, trembling sound snapped Wei Qi back to reality. His vision refocused on Xi Rongyan’s frightened face.

And in those wide, dark eyes, he saw his own reflection—no matter how he tried to hide it, the monstrous truth within him was laid bare.

Wei Qi took a deep breath and closed his eyes.

He lifted her back into his arms, then looked down at the wrist he had gripped so tightly. The fair skin was already marked with red imprints.

He paused, a flicker of tenderness in his eyes. Lowering his head, he pressed a kiss to the marks, then looked at Xi Rongyan, his expression filled with guilt. "I’m sorry."

Xi Rongyan still saw fear in Wei Qi’s eyes.

It hadn’t been her imagination.

For a moment, the Emperor had truly been terrifying.

She nodded blankly, but the hand he held still trembled slightly.

Xi Rongyan’s fearful gaze still stung Wei Qi.

He bent down and held her tightly, his silent grief the most painful of memories.

He knew he and Xi Rongyan were to have a fresh start, yet he couldn’t stop himself from revisiting every moment of their past.

Especially that final, silent moment when she had gone limp in his arms.

That had been the most obedient she had ever been with him.

By then, he had no leverage left to control her.

He knew her sorrow best.

And he had been powerless to do anything about it.

---

chapters.title: Yan'er, Hold Me Tight
chapters.content:
The inner chamber was so quiet that the fall of a needle could be heard.

Incense curled from the censer, filling the room, while dark curtains shielded them from prying eyes. On the Emperor’s bed, Xi Rongyan suddenly felt as if she couldn’t breathe.

She tried to shift slightly, but the fingers around her waist only tightened.

She heard the Emperor’s hoarse, low voice: "Yan'er, hold me tight."

Xi Rongyan froze.

She felt a warmth at her neck as the Emperor bent low, pressing his head against her shoulder. His breath fanned against her skin, and his voice carried a rare note of helpless vulnerability. "In my youth, I led armies and saw too much blood. I am often haunted by nightmares."

"Yan'er, I was just haunted again."

"I can no longer tell if I am on the battlefield or if I have already become the Emperor."

"Do you blame me?"

Xi Rongyan blinked.

Did the Emperor mean he suffered from night terrors?

No wonder his expression had suddenly shifted from tenderness to something terrifying.

Hearing the Emperor’s rare moment of vulnerability, Xi Rongyan felt a pang of sympathy.

Of course—after seeing so much death and blood, even an emperor would carry scars.

Her fingers hesitated before she lifted her arms and wrapped them around the Emperor’s waist. "This concubine does not blame Your Majesty."

Feeling her soft hands embrace him once more, Wei Qi’s uneasy heart finally settled.

He still held her, lightly kissing her fragrant neck before asking in a rough voice, "Can Yan'er take the initiative to kiss me?"

Xi Rongyan froze, not reacting in time. She watched as the Emperor lifted his head from her shoulder, his dark eyes seeming a little despondent as he looked at her. "If Yan'er is afraid of me, that’s fine too."

Xi Rongyan faltered.

She was a little afraid—but seeing the Emperor’s unwavering, burning gaze, her heart raced in confusion.

His intense stare made her nervous, so she finally admitted the truth: "But this concubine... doesn’t know how."

Xi Rongyan truly didn’t. Just the thought made her cheeks burn.

Moreover, her mother had taught her from a young age to be modest and reserved. She simply couldn’t bring herself to do it.

Wei Qi pressed his lips together but didn’t insist.

In his past life, he had never once received her initiative.

No amount of pleading had changed that.

At least now, she had taken the initiative to hold him.

The hall grew darker, and the Emperor’s face flickered in and out of shadow, exuding a silent, imperial majesty that made Xi Rongyan want to flee.

She softly said she should return, but the Emperor kept her in the Xuanzheng Hall to help him review memorials, then had her stay with him in the Mingde Hall for dinner.

As always, he carefully served her food, wanting her to eat more.

In his past life, Xi Rongyan had rarely eaten much. She had grown thinner and thinner, and it had pained him deeply.

As if driven by some obsession, Wei Qi refused to let the current Xi Rongyan become the same person who had once refused to eat properly, growing thinner by the day.

Xi Rongyan spent the entire afternoon in the Mingde Hall. Not only did the Emperor bestow many treasures upon her, but the news that she had stayed the night in his chambers quickly spread through the harem.

The Emperor had never allowed any concubine to stay in his chambers—not even the Empress.

Though their expressions varied, everyone understood one thing: the Emperor truly cherished Consort Zhen.

Xi Rongyan, however, remained oblivious to the whispers among the harem women. That morning, she had intended to go to the Empress early, but the Emperor had kept her in his arms, letting her sleep a little longer.

When she finally rose and dressed, Xi Rongyan heard the sound of someone paying respects outside the hall.

After finishing her toilet, she was led out by the Emperor, only to see the Crown Prince, Wei Heng, come to greet him.

This was the first time Xi Rongyan had seen the Crown Prince, and she curiously took him in.

The nearly six-year-old prince bore a resemblance to the Emperor, already strikingly handsome and noble at his age. Tall for his years, with a straight posture, he performed the greeting ritual with perfect etiquette.

It was clear he had been raised with great care.

Xi Rongyan secretly observed the Crown Prince, who suddenly glanced her way.

His gaze wasn’t particularly warm, but neither did it reveal any other emotion.

Xi Rongyan didn’t think much of it. If anything, she found the Crown Prince’s sharp gaze remarkably similar to the Emperor’s.

Wei Qi, however, merely glanced at Wei Heng with detachment before looking away, waving a hand to dismiss him without a single word.

The Crown Prince seemed accustomed to his father’s coldness and silently withdrew.

Xi Rongyan was surprised. She turned to look at the Emperor, only to see his expression toward the Crown Prince was indifferent, as if he were dissatisfied with him.

But she had heard from her elder brother that the palace tutors all praised the Crown Prince as capable and intelligent. Why would the Emperor dislike him?

Wei Qi noticed Xi Rongyan watching him. He smiled, personally arranging a palanquin and draping his own cloak over her shoulders, fastening it himself.

Every action was observed by the palace attendants.

Consort Zhen was the only one in the past three years to have earned such care and favor from the Emperor.

She was also the only one to have spent a night in the Mingde Hall.

And now, the Emperor himself was seeing her off—what this implied was already clear to all.

As Xi Rongyan was led into the palanquin by the Emperor, her mind was still in a daze.

She could see the unusually deferential and ingratiating looks from the palace staff—all because of the Emperor.

As the palanquin slowly moved forward, she suddenly, as if compelled by some unseen force, turned her head. She saw the Emperor still standing in place, hands clasped behind his back, watching her.

His figure was faint and blurred, but she could sense the careful protection he offered, filling her with a quiet reassurance.

Last night, the Emperor had even helped her undress, his actions never making her uncomfortable.

She could feel that he always considered her feelings, never forcing her to do anything. Instead, it was always the Emperor who took care of her.

She turned back, pressing a hand to her chest, then looked up at the newly brightened sky, her confused eyes filled with an indescribable emotion.

When she arrived at the Changchun Palace, Xi Rongyan realized the Emperor’s cloak on her shoulders was a little too conspicuous, so she removed it first.

Yet even as the cloak was taken away by a palace maid, it still stung the eyes of many.

That was the Emperor’s personal item, the only time he had ever draped it over a concubine.

In truth, it was common for the Emperor to bestow valuable personal items upon his concubines, but what pained them was his coldness coupled with favoritism—he had never done this for anyone else.

Normally, even catching a glimpse of the Emperor was harder than ascending to the heavens. Any concubine who managed to see him was already considered favored.

Like Wang Xiuyi in the past—even if the Emperor only visited her once a month, to the others, that was already a luxury.

The Empress sat upright in her seat, her smiling face concealing a deep coldness.

She watched Xi Rongyan, her fingers gripping tightly, yet she calmly and warmly gestured for her to sit.

Then, she had a matron bring forward a small box and present it to Xi Rongyan, saying with a smile, "These days, Consort Zhen has been attending to His Majesty. This box contains Buqi Bazhen Pills, which aid in conception. I bestow them upon you. It would be good if you could bear a child soon."

Xi Rongyan quickly stood to accept the box, then thanked the Empress.

After leaving, Wang Xiuyi walked beside Xi Rongyan, casting a deep glance at the box in Xi Rongyan’s hands before looking at her and whispering, "You are truly fortunate, sister. The Bazhen Pills are good, but don’t take too many."

chapters.title: The Emperor's Scent
chapters.content:
Xi Rongyan understood Wang Xiuyi's implication.

Wang Xiuyi probably suspected the medicine was problematic.

Xi Rongyan hadn't expected Wang Xiuyi to warn her. As for Wang Xiuyi, whether her tears while leaning on her yesterday were genuine or feigned, she still couldn't fathom her intentions.

She smiled softly at her, "Sister, rest assured, I’ve never been fond of such things."

Wang Xiuyi turned her head to look at Xi Rongyan. There was a familiar scent on her.

It was the Emperor’s scent.

She envied Xi Rongyan deep down, but seeing her unchanged demeanor from their maiden days, she felt jealousy yet no hatred toward her.

These days, many around her had tried to incite her hatred toward Xi Rongyan, blaming her for the Emperor’s coldness toward her. But she knew the Emperor could never be swayed by anyone.

The Emperor had never even touched her.

Those who provoked her only wanted to use her as a pawn at the forefront.

The real beneficiary would be the one pulling the strings from behind.

She was nothing but a chess piece.

Wang Baoran held Xi Rongyan’s hand in silence.

Xi Rongyan invited Wang Baoran to sit and talk with her, but Wang Baoran glanced at Qi Fei and Hui Fei from the corner of her eye and shook her head, "I reside in the West Palace, which is a bit far from yours, sister. I’ll visit you another time when I’m free."

Xi Rongyan nodded in understanding and didn’t insist.

Xie Yumian still stood behind, watching Xi Rongyan and Wang Baoran together, nearly rubbing a hole in her handkerchief.

Lu Zhaoyi observed Xie Yumian’s expression, walked over, and stood beside her, saying, "I heard that Consort Xie is the cousin of Zhen Pin, yet Zhen Pin doesn’t seem close to you. Instead, she’s close to Wang Xiuyi."

She laughed again, "Moreover, with your families being so close, and Zhen Pin being so favored now, haven’t you thought of helping your cousin?"

"Look at Zhen Pin, living alone in the main hall of Qiong Ze Palace, with so many empty rooms."

"Tsk tsk, it seems the relationship between Consort Xie and Zhen Pin is nothing special."

"Indeed, who would be willing to share favor?"

After saying this, Lu Zhaoyi glanced at Xie Yumian again, her eyes filled with mockery and sarcasm, before walking past her leisurely.

Xie Yumian’s fingers trembled slightly.

She looked again at Xi Rongyan and Wang Baoran standing close together, then walked over.

Hui Fei followed the Empress into the inner hall.

Empress Song Helan glanced at her and knew what she wanted to say. She waved her hand, signaling her to leave.

Hui Fei was startled but still said, "This concubine’s palace maid, Wang Xiuyi, seems a bit disobedient lately. She hasn’t made a move for a long time."

"Should Your Majesty the Empress urge her a bit?"

The Empress wearily rubbed her temples, raised her eyebrows, and looked at Hui Fei with a cold smile, "Why are you so impatient? Have you forgotten what happened to Yu Ning?"

Hui Fei then realized.

Song Yuning was still locked up in Yan Qiu Palace.

She had once wanted to visit, but the palace gates were tightly guarded, and no one was allowed in.

She had heard some tragic screams from inside, which made her heart tremble.

She covered her chest and asked the Empress, "Are we just going to watch her gain favor? What if she really conceives a prince?"

"The Dowager Empress will definitely support her from behind."

"The Dowager Empress sent her into the palace precisely to elevate Xi Rongyan’s status."

Empress Song Helan leaned diagonally on the round embroidered pillow, her expression unreadable as the light fell into her eyes.

She naturally knew the Dowager Empress would help Xi Rongyan.

But she also knew Xi Rongyan’s place in the Emperor’s heart.

The Emperor, who had never cared about the harem, had specially come to warn her for Xi Rongyan’s sake.

She knew clearly that in the Emperor’s eyes, none of the women in the harem mattered, except for Xi Rongyan.

She also knew that the Emperor was not one to easily fall in love. As long as Xi Rongyan bore a prince, the crown prince would undoubtedly be her child.

She could allow Xi Rongyan to be favored, but she could not allow her to have offspring.

This was an unsolvable dilemma.

Moreover, she couldn’t take any action at all.

She glanced indifferently at Hui Fei’s frown, "If Zhen Pin can bear children for His Majesty, it would be a good thing. I only wish for harmony in the harem. As long as Zhen Pin doesn’t cause trouble, I won’t interfere."

Hui Fei was stunned. This didn’t align with what the Empress had said before.

Just as she was about to speak, she heard the Empress continue, "Let me say one more thing. My position is naturally secure, but yours may not be."

"The Emperor’s favor for Zhen Pin will only grow stronger. What do we, the old servants of the Prince’s residence, count for? The Emperor might even abandon the harem for Zhen Pin."

"I am the Empress; the Emperor won’t easily act against me. But what about you?"

The Empress sighed softly, "My impulsive cousin is likely to be locked up for life. Even I cannot save her after pleading with the Emperor."

"You should also look after your own blessings."

Hui Fei was taken aback, sensing something unusual in the Empress’s words.

Could the Emperor’s favor for Zhen Pin go this far?

As she was about to question the Empress further, the Empress stood up without another word and entered the inner room, leaving only her back to Hui Fei, which made her feel uneasy.

Did the Empress mean that Consort Xian’s fate would be their fate as well?

While she was lost in thought, a palace matron approached and whispered, "Hui Fei, Her Majesty the Empress wishes to rest now."

Hui Fei finally realized and stood up, then left.

Inside, the Empress held a cat in her arms and looked at the entering Yu Mama, asking calmly, "What do you think? How long will the Emperor favor Zhen Pin?"

Yu Mama stepped beside the Empress but gently shook her head, "This old servant does not know."

The Empress smiled, but behind the smile was a trace of coldness.

She and the Emperor had been married for seven years, yet they couldn’t even be considered as maintaining a respectful distance.

The Emperor was so cold that no one dared approach him. Even as his wedded wife, she had never dared to show the slightest overstepping or intimate gesture in front of him.

He handled his state affairs, and she quietly managed the rear court.

Back in the Prince’s residence, there were times when they didn’t see each other for months.

She still remembered the first two months after their marriage. She was just a woman filled with admiration, thinking that she and the Emperor would grow old together. Even if not deeply in love, they would at least share a harmonious and intimate understanding.

She would always inquire about the Emperor’s preferences, always wanting to get closer to him.

Without exception, the Emperor looked at her as if she were insignificant, indifferent to every single thing she did for him.

Even when they shared a bed, the Emperor treated it as a mere duty, and he never stayed in her room afterward.

When she gave birth, he merely glanced at the child from outside before leaving.

After that, she completely gave up hope.

She calmed her heart, letting it grow as cold as the Emperor’s, not allowing herself to feel the slightest emotion.

She only wanted glory.

This life could have passed like this, but that different person appeared.

She directly threatened her child and her honor.

This was the only thing she could not tolerate.

She could live without a man’s love, but not without dignity.

The Empress’s eyes gradually narrowed, her long nails tapping on the small table. What was so different about this Xi Rongyan?

---

chapters.title: Taking the Initiative
chapters.content:
By the time Xie Yumian approached Xi Rongyan, Wang Baoran had already left her side.

She opened her mouth to call out to Xi Rongyan, only to see a palanquin stopped in front of her, respectfully inviting Xi Rongyan to board.

Suddenly, all her words stuck in her throat.

Xi Rongyan was currently in favor, while she was nothing but an insignificant tile in the corner.

She watched as Xi Rongyan gradually disappeared from her sight, surrounded by eunuchs and palace maids, as if the Xi Rongyan of the past was also drifting further and further away from her.

No longer was she the cousin who used to be close and dependent on her.

Who would genuinely wish to have the Emperor’s favor taken away? All she wanted was for the Emperor to notice her.

She stood in place for a long time before being summoned to Changchun Palace by the Empress’s people.

Xi Rongyan, who was in the palanquin, had initially refused to ride, but the young eunuch beside her said it was the Emperor’s order. Not wanting to make things difficult, she boarded.

Sitting in the sedan chair, she looked back but didn’t see Xie Yumian. Perhaps her cousin had left first while she was talking to Wang Baoran.

Actually, she was concerned about the matter her cousin had mentioned. Last night, she had asked the Emperor about it again, but he had still been vague, telling her to wait a little longer.

Hearing the Emperor’s evasive words, she knew she couldn’t ask again. Previously, the Emperor had said to let the Empress handle it. She feared that the Empress had already made a decision, and asking again would be useless. She could only wait.

After returning to Hanyuan Palace, the managing mama placed yesterday’s rewards from the Emperor in front of Xi Rongyan.

Each item was displayed on a silver tray, all exquisite and dazzling, making even Baozhu and Yuzhu beside her widen their eyes.

In the past, their mistress’s jewelry had already been the finest in the capital. This time, when their mistress entered the palace, the madam had prepared exquisite items for her to avoid being outshone in the palace.

But the items in the palace were even more exquisite. The gold-threaded silk hairpin had threads as fine as hair, and the emerald jade was translucently green. Each piece was invaluable, and the Emperor had actually bestowed so many at once.

Baozhu exclaimed happily, "The Emperor truly dotes on Mistress. Bestowing so many gifts at once, how grand it will be to wear them out!"

Xi Rongyan reached out to touch the row of jewelry before her. A strange emotion suddenly arose in her heart, as if she had a vague aversion to this scene, as though she had witnessed it before.

But she was certain she had never seen such a scene, nor did she know where this feeling came from.

She then softly asked the mama beside her, "Can I give these things to others?"

The managing mama looked at Xi Rongyan and smiled, "These are gifts specially bestowed by His Majesty to Mistress. If one day the Emperor sees them on someone else’s head, what would His Majesty think?"

Xi Rongyan actually knew this, but she asked casually, thinking of sending a couple of pieces to her cousin.

There were simply too many, and she couldn’t possibly wear them all.

She didn’t examine them further, having Baozhu put them away carefully. Then she went to the inner room, leaned against the noble consort’s couch, and took the box of medicine the Empress had bestowed from Yuzhu’s hands, opening it.

A strange fragrance wafted out. Xi Rongyan asked, "Do you think there’s something wrong with this medicine?"

Yuzhu stood beside Xi Rongyan, pondering for a moment, "Her Majesty the Empress probably wouldn’t dare to harm Mistress so openly."

"But it’s better to be cautious. Mistress had best not touch it."

Xi Rongyan looked at the pills in the box, then closed it and handed it to Baozhu.

Regardless of whether there was a problem or not, she wouldn’t touch it.

Yuzhu bent down and whispered to ask about last night’s affairs with the Emperor. Xi Rongyan felt a bit helpless that Yuzhu was always concerned about this.

She said, "The Emperor hasn’t touched me yet..."

Yuzhu was startled.

After sleeping together for so many nights, how could they still not have consummated the marriage?

She hesitated, then asked in an extremely low voice, "Could it be that His Majesty has some hidden ailment?"

The Emperor was already twenty-five, yet he only had one prince and one princess, with eleven or twelve consorts in the harem. It didn’t seem normal. Could it be true? If so, then the girls entering the palace would be doomed.

Xi Rongyan suddenly understood Yuzhu’s implication.

But she recalled the morning when the Emperor had pressed against her—it didn’t seem like that was the case.

Actually, she didn’t understand either.

The Emperor clearly didn’t seem completely unresponsive, so why...

Or was there really some other hidden condition?

She had never tried, only read the manual, and didn’t understand at all. She just shook her head vaguely.

Yuzhu was stunned, then genuinely worried, "Then why doesn’t Mistress take the initiative this time?"

Xi Rongyan looked up, and for some reason, the images from the manual came to mind, a faint blush rising to her ears, "How to take the initiative?"

Yuzhu still had some experience. She bent down and whispered a sentence into Xi Rongyan’s ear.

This time, Xi Rongyan’s entire face turned red, and she hurriedly shook her head.

She really couldn’t do that.

Asking her to take off her clothes and sit on the Emperor—she couldn’t even bear to think about it.

Yuzhu took a deep breath and leaned in again, whispering another sentence into Xi Rongyan’s ear.

Xi Rongyan listened, her cheeks still flushed, hesitating, "This... this..."

Xi Rongyan wasn’t being coy; she truly couldn’t bring herself to do such things due to her upbringing as a noble lady.

She sighed and looked at Yuzhu, "Don’t say any more. Let me think about it."

Yuzhu saw that Xi Rongyan was somewhat wavering and stopped persuading her. Indeed, it was difficult to ask Mistress to take the initiative in such seductive matters.

In the evening, the Emperor didn’t come, but Eunuch Gao did.

Eunuch Gao waited outside with a smile, inviting Xi Rongyan to Chonghua Palace.

Chonghua Palace was where the Emperor specially bathed. Inviting Xi Rongyan there now clearly meant he wanted her to join him for a bath.

As Xi Rongyan boarded the sedan chair, she asked Eunuch Gao, "Is His Majesty there as well?"

Gao Yi smiled, "Your Majesty, please go first. His Majesty will come as soon as he finishes his business."

"It won’t be too long."

Xi Rongyan didn’t ask further.

Inside Chonghua Palace, white mist swirled, and the floor was paved with jade tiles. The golden dragon-engraved pillars appeared and disappeared in the fog. The central bath looked large enough to hold a hundred people.

As soon as she entered, she felt the mist and heat.

Layers of curtains hung around like a maze, and the heat made her feel slightly dizzy.

But she had no time to think deeply. Soon, two palace maids approached and reached out to undress her.

Xi Rongyan was very uncomfortable. She looked around, her gaze falling on the vividly carved nine-clawed golden dragon on the wall. Its fierce and sharp eyes seemed to stare at her through the mist, and she suddenly felt a surge of fear, instinctively taking a step back.

chapters.title: Bath Pool
chapters.content:
